찾던 중에 너무나도 럭키하게 제눈에 들어온 Henne bag!! 컬러 고민 끝에 카라멜 브라운으로 선택했습니다
판매자님의 친절한 응대도 너무 감사했구요:)
집에 안쓰는 스카프로 손잡이부분 감아주니까 더 예쁜 것 같아요
한동안 육아휴직에 가족사업으로 안했던 제 일을 이제 다시 시작하면서
저에게 주는 선물이었습니다 감사히 잘 쓸게요 미니버전도 나오면 구매하러 오겠습니다!!
text.JA:
16インチのMacBook Proを使っている者です。
ミーティング用に良いバッグを一つ買いたいと思っていました
探している中でとてもラッキーに私の目に留まったHenne bag!!色で悩んだ末にキャラメルブラウンを選びました
販売者様の親切な対応にもとても感謝しています:)
家で使っていないスカーフを持ち手に巻いてあげるともっと綺麗な気がします
しばらく育児休業と家業でやっていなかった自分の仕事をまた始めるにあたって
自分へのご褒美でした。大切に使わせていただきます。ミニバージョンが出たらまた買いに来ます!!
text.EN:
I am using a 16-inch MacBook Pro.
I wanted to buy a good bag for meetings.
While I was looking for it, I was so lucky that the Henne bag caught my eye!! After thinking about the color, I chose caramel brown.
I was also very grateful for the seller's friendly response :)
I think it looks prettier because I wrap the handle with a scarf that I don’t use at home.
I am now starting my own business again, which I had not been doing for a while due to my family business while on parental leave.
It was a gift to me. I will use it gratefully. I will come buy the mini version when it comes out!!

text.KO:
보자마자 한눈에 반해서 겟해버린 백
너무너무 맘에들어요
깔끔하고 수납력좋은데 디자인까지 완벽
아직까지 백팩중에 이렇게 예쁜 아이보리백은 못본거같아오
오염걱정도 생각보다 없고
보는 사람들 마다 예쁘대요!
이런 가방 많이 만들어주세오
새해 복 많이받으세요!!
text.JA:
見た瞬間、一目惚れして買ってしまったバッグ
本当に本当に気に入っています
すっきりしていて収納力も良い上にデザインまで完璧
これまでこんなに綺麗なアイボリーのバッグは見たことがない気がします
汚れの心配も思ったより少なくて
見る人みんなが綺麗だと言ってくれます!
こういうバッグをたくさん作ってください
良いお年をお迎えください!!
text.EN:
I fell in love with the bag as soon as I saw it and got it.
I like it so much
It's clean, has good storage capacity, and even the design is perfect.
I don't think I've ever seen such a pretty ivory bag among backpacks.
There is no need to worry about contamination.
Everyone who sees it says it’s pretty!
Please make more bags like this.
Happy New Year!!

text.KO:
상품주문하고 이틀뒤에 받았어요~^^
생각보다도 너무 이쁘고 색감도 이뻐서 고민하지않고 사도 됐겠다  싶어요^^
사이즈도 적당하고 안에 자석으로  닫을 수 있게 되어서  더 좋은거같아요
다만, 바깥에 나오는 카드지갑의 경ㅈ우에는  가방속 포켓에 넣어서 배송이 되었는데  넣는 과정에서 잘못 들어간건지 구겨져서 책으로 눌러서 펴서 사용하려고합니다
그래도 전체적으로 너무 만족합니다♡
text.JA:
商品を注文して2日後に届きました〜^^
思ったよりもすごく綺麗で色味も綺麗で、悩まずに買ってよかったなと思います^^
サイズもちょうどよくて、中が磁石で閉められるようになっているのがさらに良い気がします
ただ、外に出ているカードウォレットの場合、バッグの中のポケットに入れて配送されたんですが、入れる過程で間違って入ったのか少ししわが寄っていて、本で挟んで伸ばして使おうと思います
それでも全体的にはとても満足しています♡
text.EN:
I ordered the product and received it two days later~^^
It was so much prettier than I thought and the color was pretty, so I thought I could buy it without hesitation^^
The size is just right, and I think it's even better because it can be closed with a magnet on the inside.
However, in the case of the card wallet that comes out, it was delivered in a pocket inside the bag, but it was crumpled during the process of putting it in, so I tried to use it by pressing it with a book and unfolding it.
Still, overall I am very satisfied♡

text.KO:
보부상은 아니지만 정리정돈 안되는 가방 너무 싫어하는데
이건 뭐 제가 따로 정리할 필요도 없고~
남편도 처음엔 또(?) 가방 샀냐고 하더니
들고다니고, 안쪽 수납보더니 이건 진짜 잘샀다 라고 인정받았습니다 ㅋㅋ
임산부인데도 들고다니기 가볍고 편해요!
특히, 제가 강사라 수업다니는데 패드도 들어가니까 뭐^^
완전 추천합니다.
브라운이 블랙룩, 화이트룩에도 무난히 잘 어울려서 잘 산거 같아요!!
text.JA:
荷物が多いタイプではないんですが、整理整頓できないバッグはすごく苦手で
これは私が特に整理する必要もなくて〜
夫も最初は「また(?)バッグ買ったの」と言っていたんですが
持ち歩いているところや内部の収納を見て、これは本当に良い買い物だったと認めてくれました笑
妊娠中でも持ち歩くのが軽くて楽です!
特に私は講師で授業に行くんですが、タブレットも入るので^^
完全におすすめです。
ブラウンがブラックコーデにもホワイトコーデにも無難によく合って良い買い物をした気がします!!
text.EN:
I'm not someone who carries a lot of things, but I really hate disorganized bags.
There is no need for me to organize this separately.
At first, my husband also asked if I had bought a bag again(?).
After carrying it around and looking at the storage inside, he admitted that it was a really good purchase haha.
It’s light and comfortable to carry even if you’re pregnant!
Especially, since I am an instructor and attend classes, I can also fit my tablet. ^^
I totally recommend it.
I think it was a good purchase because brown goes well with black and white looks!!

text.KO:
가죽 질도 너무 좋구 바닐라 색상 너무 예쁩니다 ㅠㅠ
안에 포켓별로 수납도 너무 잘 되어있구
모양 흐트러지지않게 잡아주는것꺼지 디테일 너무 맘에 들어요 특히 안감 색상과 바닐라랑 너무 잘어울려서 열때마다 기분이 좋아요유 🫶
++++
이번에 아로백을 챙겨서 여행을 다니고 있는데 너무 좋아서 추가 올려요
이너에 순서대로 여권 볼펜 립 그리고 머리끈까지 달수있는 똑딱이.. 정말 완벽합니다
필요할때 당황하지 않고 바로바로 찾을 수 있어요
앞에는 인공눈물, 작은 usb 충전선
뒤에는 자주 쓰는 카드 2가지 챙겨서 이제는 지갑을 따로 찾지 않아도 되어요 ㅜ.ㅜ
이너에는 또 추가적으로 생리대도 넣을수있고 그 뒤에는 파스까지 넣는 공간이 나와서
정말 하나의 가방에서 다양한 수납의 매력을 느꼈습니다
물론 디자인과 이너백 색상도 말모..🩵🩵🩵
text.JA:
革の質もすごく良くて、バニラカラーがすごく綺麗です(涙)
中もポケットごとにすごくきちんと収納できていて
形が崩れないようキープしてくれるところまでディテールがすごく気に入っています。特に裏地の色とバニラがすごく合っていて、開けるたびに気分が良くなります🫶
++++
今回アロバッグを持って旅行しているんですが、すごく良いので追記します
インナーには順番にパスポート、ボールペン、リップ、そして髪ゴムまで留められるスナップ..本当に完璧です
必要な時に慌てずすぐ見つけられます
前にはドライアイの目薬、小さいUSB充電ケーブル
後ろにはよく使うカード2枚を入れて、もう財布を別に探さなくてよくなりました(涙)
インナーにはさらに生理用品も入れられて、その後ろには湿布まで入るスペースがあって
本当に一つのバッグでいろんな収納の魅力を感じました
もちろんデザインとインナーバッグの色も言うことなし..🩵🩵🩵
text.EN:
The quality of the leather is very good and the vanilla color is very pretty.
The storage inside each pocket is very good.
It holds the shape so it doesn't lose its shape. I really like the details. It goes especially well with the lining color and vanilla, so I feel good every time I open it. 🫶
++++
I'm traveling with arrow bags this time, and I like them so much that I'm adding them.
A snap that allows you to attach a passport, ballpoint pen lip, and even a hair tie to the inner part in that order... It's really perfect.
When you need it, you can find it right away without panicking.
Artificial tears in front, small USB charging cable
I put two frequently used cards in my back, so I don't have to look for my wallet anymore ㅜ.ㅜ
You can also put additional sanitary pads in the inner, and there is a space behind it to put a patch.
I really felt the charm of various storage options in one bag.
Of course, the design and inner bag color are also...🩵🩵🩵

text.KO:
컬러 고민을 엄청 하다가, 흔하지 않은 토프컬러로 골랐어요!
블랙, 카멜, 버터 색상들 모두모두 너무 이뻐서 컬러고민이 많았어요.
예전에 에토프 컬러에 꽂혀서 한창 가방 찾았었는데, 토프컬러 가죽가방이 찾기 은근 힘들기도 했고
다른 컬러들은 집에 있기도 해서 토프컬러로 골랐습니다!
비마이연 헨느백 토프컬러는 또 약간 어두운색이라.. 다른 토프들과 달라요.... 고민하느라 진짜 미치는줄...(그만큼 이쁘다는 뜻!)
받아보니 실물은 훨씬 더 더 더 이쁜 가방이었습니다 ㅠㅠ
토프가 고민되신다? 무조건 강추드려요!
수납은 말해모해 ~ 스티치도 정교하고, 쉐입도 탄탄해 안무너지고 여러모로 정말 이쁜 가방입니다!!
text.JA:
カラーですごく悩んでから、あまり見かけないトープカラーを選びました!
ブラック、キャメル、バター、どのカラーもすごく綺麗でカラー選びにすごく悩みました。
以前トープカラーにはまってバッグをずっと探していたんですが、トープカラーの革バッグって意外と見つけにくくて
他のカラーはすでに家にあったのでトープカラーを選びました!
yyeonのヘンヌバッグのトープカラーはちょっと暗めの色で..他のトープとはまた違います....悩みすぎてどうにかなりそうでした...（それだけ綺麗ってことです!）
受け取ってみると実物はもっともっともっと綺麗なバッグでした(涙)
トープで悩んでいる方?絶対おすすめします!
収納力は言うまでもなく〜 ステッチも丁寧で、形もしっかりしていて崩れず、いろんな面で本当に綺麗なバッグです!!
text.EN:
After thinking a lot about the color, I chose an uncommon taupe color!
I had a lot of trouble with the colors because the black, camel, and butter colors were all so pretty.
In the past, I was obsessed with the Etoffe color and was looking for a bag, but it was quite difficult to find a taupe colored leather bag.
I chose the taupe color because I had other colors at home!
The color of the Bee Maiyeon Henne bag taupe is a bit dark... so it's different from other taupes... I'm really going crazy thinking about it... (meaning it's that pretty!)
When I received it, it was a much prettier bag in real life.
Are you worried about Toph? I definitely recommend it!
Storage is a breeze. The stitching is precise, the shape is solid, so it doesn't fall apart, and it's a really pretty bag in many ways!!

text.KO:
진짜 말 그대로
매일 매고 다니는 가방
이에요.
회사 갈 때도, 주말에 가볍게 나갈 때도 다 잘 어울리고
수납력도 좋아서 파우치, 지갑, 텀블러까지 다 들어가요.
가방이 가벼워서 어깨도 안 아파요.
디자인·실용성·착용감 다 잡은 가방이라
다음에 색상 다른 것도 또 살 예정입니다!
text.JA:
本当に文字通り
毎日使っているバッグ
です。
会社に行く時も、週末気軽に出かける時も全部よく合いますし
収納力も良くてポーチ、財布、タンブラーまで全部入ります。
バッグが軽いので肩も痛くなりません。
デザイン・実用性・着け心地全部揃ったバッグなので
次は他のカラーも買う予定です!
text.EN:
really literally
The bag I wear every day
This is it.
It goes well with both going to work and going out on the weekend.
It has good storage capacity, so it can fit everything from pouches, wallets, and tumblers.
The bag is light, so my shoulders don’t hurt.
This is a bag that combines design, practicality, and comfort.
I plan to buy another color next time!

text.KO:
헨느는 저에게 너무 큰 것 같아 더 작은 사이즈를 기다리고 있었는데 막상 미디움이 나왔을 때도 조금은 고민했지만, 들고 다닌 후에는
고민한 시간이 아깝기만 했어요
😇🤍
일단 예쁩니다.
무엇보다 예쁘지 않으면 선택의 기준에서 제외되기 마련! 헨느 미디움은 일단 디자인부터 세련되고, 그 속에서도 귀여움을 더해 군더더기 없는 모습으로 제 눈길을 사로잡았어요.
탄탄한 바닥과 무너지지 않는 바디쉐입으로 평소 딱 제가 원하는 스타일
이었답니다.
가벼워요.
가죽이지이만 무겁지 않을 것. 유럽여행 중 이탈리아 현지에서 산 장인의 명품 가죽가방을 샀을 때, 다 좋았지만 무거워서 오래들지 못했어요. 가죽의 한계인가 생각했는데, 헨느 미디움은 가벼워서
오래들어도 피로감이 덜했어요.
고급스러움
여느 명품 가방 못지 않게 고급스러워서 택했어요. 블랙은 흔하고 카라멜은 밝은 편이라 생각해 토프모카를 택했는데,
캐주얼과 비즈니스 어디에도 어울리며 소장가치가 높은 컬러
라 생각했습니다.
완벽한 2way
아니 솔직히 이건 좀 반칙이라 생각했어요. 기존의 다른 가방들은 한쪽 면으로만 들고 다녔는데, 헨느는 앞면 뒷면 다 완벽합니다. 저는 일부로라도 맘에드는 한쪽 면만 보이도록 가방을 메거나 들고 다니는데, 헨느는 들고 다니며
어느 쪽으로 보여도 다 예쁘고 마음에 들어요!
편리함을 갖춘 내부
파우치 프리라는 yyeon의 핵심 기술!! 저는 가방에 여러 파우치들을 나눠 들고 다녔던 사람으로서, 한칸한칸 신경써서 만든 내부 구조들이 최고라 생각합니다. 파우치 없이도
가방 내부가 깔끔할 수 있더라구요
여러 모로 예쁘고 편리하고 완벽한 헨느 미디움.
하나만 구입한게 가장 실수한 점
인 만큼, 또 다른 컬러도 진작 살 걸 그랬네요. 좋은 가방 만들어주셔서 감사합니다!🤍
text.JA:
ヘンヌが私には大きすぎる気がしてもっと小さいサイズを待っていたんですが、いざミディアムが出た時も少し悩みましたが、持ち歩いてみたら
悩んだ時間がもったいなかったです
😇🤍
まず可愛いです。
何より可愛くなければ選択の基準から外れてしまうもの!ヘンヌミディアムはまずデザインから洗練されていて、その中に可愛らしさも加わって無駄のない姿で私の目を引きました。
しっかりした底とへたらないボディシェイプで普段私が求めていたスタイル
でした。
軽いです。
革だけど重くないこと。ヨーロッパ旅行中イタリア現地で買った職人の高級革バッグを買った時、全部良かったんですが重くて長く持てませんでした。革の限界かと思ったんですが、ヘンヌミディアムは軽くて
長く持っても疲れが少なかったです。
高級感
どのハイブランドバッグにも負けないくらい高級感があって選びました。ブラックはよくあるし、キャラメルは明るめだと思ってトープモカを選んだんですが、
カジュアルにもビジネスにもどこでも合って所有価値の高いカラー
だと思いました。
完璧な2way
いや正直これはちょっと反則だと思いました。既存の他のバッグは片面だけを見せて持ち歩いていましたが、ヘンヌは前面も背面も両方完璧です。私はわざと気に入ったほうの面だけ見えるようにバッグを掛けたり持ち歩いたりしていたんですが、ヘンヌは持ち歩いていて
どちら側から見ても全部可愛くて気に入っています!
利便性を備えた内部
ポーチフリーというyyeonの核心技術!!私はバッグの中にいろんなポーチを分けて持ち歩いていた人間として、一区画一区画丁寧に作られた内部構造が最高だと思います。ポーチなしでも
バッグの中がすっきりできるんですね
いろんな面で可愛くて便利で完璧なヘンヌミディアム。
一つだけ買ったのが一番の失敗
なくらい、他のカラーも早く買っておけばよかったです。良いバッグを作ってくださってありがとうございます!🤍
text.EN:
I thought the Henne was too big for me, so I was waiting for a smaller size, and when the medium came out, I was a little concerned, but after carrying it around, I liked it.
It was a waste of time to think about it.
😇🤍
First of all, it's pretty.
Above all, if you are not pretty, you will be excluded from the selection criteria! Henne Medium first caught my eye with its sophisticated design, but also with its cute, no-frills look.
With a solid base and a body shape that doesn't collapse, it's just the style I want
It was.
It's light.
It should be leather but not heavy. When I bought a luxury leather bag from a local Italian craftsman while traveling in Europe, it was all good, but it was so heavy that I couldn't carry it for long. I thought it was the limit of leather, but Henne Medium is light.
Even after listening for a long time, I felt less tired.
luxury
I chose it because it is as luxurious as any other luxury bag. I chose taupe mocha because I thought black was common and caramel was bright.
A highly collectible color that goes well with both casual and business.
I thought so.
perfect 2way
No, honestly, I thought this was a bit illegal. Other existing bags were carried only on one side, but Henne is perfect on both the front and back. I carry or carry my bag so that only one side of it I like is visible, but Henne carries it around.
No matter which way you look at it, it's pretty and I like it!
Interior with convenience
yyeon’s core technology is pouch-free!! As someone who used to carry multiple pouches in my bag, I think the internal structure that was carefully made for each and every item is the best. Even without a pouch
The inside of the bag could be neat.
Henne Medium is pretty, convenient, and perfect in many ways.
The biggest mistake I made was buying just one.
As such, I should have bought another color a long time ago. Thank you for making a great bag!🤍

text.KO:
가방을 사고 싶어 디자이너 가방을 알아보다가 인스타에서 발견한 비마이연(yyeon) 브랜드 !!

text.JA:

text.EN:

text.KO:
가방을 처음 받아들었을 때, 솔직히 “이건 매일 들게 되겠다”라는 생각이 바로 들었어요. 블랙 컬러에 화이트 스티치가 들어간 디자인이 은은하게 고급스럽고, 전면에 달린 작은 포켓이 포인트가 돼서 흔하지 않은 느낌이었거든요.
처음에는 출근할 때만 들 생각이었는데, 막상 며칠 써보니까 출근, 주말 카페, 친구랑 약속까지 다 이 가방만 찾게 되더라구요. 실제로 친구랑 카페 갔을 때도 가방 어디서 샀어? 넘예뿌다라는 말을 들어서 괜히 뿌듯했고...다른색 고민중이에여 ㅋㅋ 😊
수납력은 생각보다 훨씬 만족스러웠어요. 저는 기본적으로 지갑, 핸드폰, 파우치, 다이어리, 작은 보틀까지 들고 다니는데, 이 모든 게 들어가도 가방 모양이 전혀 무너지지 않더라구요. 바닥 받침 덕분에 테이블 위에 내려놔도 안정감 있고, 모양이 흐트러지지 않는 게 정말 좋았어요.
특히 전면 미니포켓은 교통카드를 넣어두니 너무 편했어요! 미니 포켓 자체도 엄청 포인트가 되구요! 작은 디테일인데 생활할 때 큰 차이를 만드는 부분이라 만족도가 높았어요.
재질은 가볍지만 탄탄해서 오래 들어도 손목이나 어깨에 부담이 없고, 관리도 쉬울 것 같아 마음이 놓였어요. 무엇보다 손잡이와 스트랩이 둘 다 있어서, 토트백으로 들면 단정하고, 크로스로 메면 캐주얼한 무드가 돼서 상황에 따라 다르게 연출할 수 있는 점이 최고예요. 비마이연 백팩도 얼른 출시해주세요 짱기대중😍
text.JA:
バッグを最初に受け取った時、正直「これは毎日使うことになりそう」とすぐ思いました。ブラックにホワイトステッチが入ったデザインがほのかに高級感があって、前面に付いた小さいポケットがポイントになって珍しい感じでした。
最初は出勤時だけ使うつもりでしたが、いざ数日使ってみると出勤、週末のカフェ、友達との約束まで全部このバッグばかり手が伸びました。実際友達とカフェに行った時もバッグどこで買ったの、すごく可愛いと言われて誇らしくなって...他の色も悩んでいます笑😊
収納力は思ったよりずっと満足でした。私は基本的に財布、スマホ、ポーチ、手帳、小さいボトルまで持ち歩くんですが、これ全部入れてもバッグの形が全く崩れませんでした。底の支えのおかげでテーブルの上に置いても安定感があって、形が崩れないのが本当に良かったです。
特に前面のミニポケットは交通カードを入れておくとすごく便利でした!ミニポケット自体もすごくポイントになりますし!小さいディテールなんですが生活する上で大きな差を作る部分なので満足度が高かったです。
素材は軽いけどしっかりしていて長く持っても手首や肩に負担がなく、手入れも楽そうで安心しました。何より持ち手とストラップが両方あるので、トートで持てばきちんとした印象に、クロスで掛ければカジュアルな雰囲気になって、状況に応じて違う演出ができる点が最高です。yyeonのバックパックも早く発売してください、すごく楽しみです😍
text.EN:
When I first received the bag, I honestly thought, “I’m going to carry this every day.” The black design with white stitching was subtly luxurious, and the small pocket on the front was the focal point, so it felt unusual.
At first, I only planned to carry it when going to work, but after using it for a few days, I found myself reaching for this bag every time I went to work, at a cafe on the weekend, or even to an appointment with a friend. Where did you actually buy the bag when you went to the cafe with your friend? I was proud to hear that it was really pretty... and I'm thinking about a different color haha 😊
I was much more satisfied with the storage capacity than I expected. Basically, I carry a wallet, cell phone, pouch, diary, and even a small bottle, and even with all of these things in it, the bag doesn't lose its shape at all. I really liked that the bottom support made it stable even when placed on the table, and the shape didn't get lost.
In particular, the front mini pocket was very convenient for storing transportation cards! The mini pocket itself is also a great point! It's a small detail, but it makes a big difference in everyday life, so I was very satisfied.
The material is light but sturdy, so there is no strain on my wrists or shoulders even if I wear it for a long time, and I was relieved that it would be easy to maintain. Best of all, it has both a handle and a strap, so it looks neat when worn as a tote bag, and it creates a casual mood when worn cross-body, allowing you to look different depending on the situation. Please release the Bimayeon backpack as soon as possible😍

text.KO:
이직하려는 회사에 출근 가방으로 사용하고자 주문했습니다.
평소 큰 키와 보부상력으로 빅백을 선호해요.
정말 저가 브랜드부터 명품 브랜드까지시중 판매되는 큰 사이즈 백들은 전부 사용해본 것 같아요.
그렇기에 항상 모든 걸 만족하는 가방이 없어서 아쉬움또한 컸던 것 같네요.
우선 CS가 상당히 친절하고 좋았습니다. 요즘 디자이너 브랜드들, 작은 브랜드들 정말 많은데 좋은 상품들 판매해도 서비스 부분에서 호감이 가지 않는 경우가 많아요.
그런데 기다리는 시간이며 물건을 받지까지 그런 불편함이 없었다는 것도 한 몫하네요.
다음으로는 무게감과 가죽의 질감이었어요.
집에 소장하고 있는 빅백들 다 꺼내서 비교해봤습니다. 이정도 사이즈에 이런 무게감이 나오기 쉽지 않아요. 더군다나 가죽을 사용한 가방일 경우에는 더더욱!
그리고 가죽질감입니다. 선택을 굉장히 잘 하신 것 같아요. 큰 가방에 짐까지 많이 들어갈 경우, 하드한 가죽을 사용하면 매는 어깨며 쓸리는 팔에도 무리가 가고 쉐입이 지나치게 유지되기에
편안하게 매기에 쉽지 않습니다. 그런데 적당히 소프트한 가죽을 사용하면서 패턴을 알차게 써서 한쪽으로 쏠림이 있거나 무너지지 않아요, 들거나 맸을 때는 필요한 선에서 쉐입이 맞춰지고요.
저도 무언가를 만들어가는 사람이기에 고민하고 연구하는 작업을 중요하게 생각합니다.
진심을 담아 직접 경험하고 고민했던 순간들이 담겨있는 가방 이라는 생각이 들었어요. 단순히 디자인이 예쁜 유니크한 상품들을 판매하는 게 아닌 실용성을 생각하고 배려하려고 한 흔적이 보여지네요.
새로운 좋은 브랜드를 알게 되어 기쁘네요.
미디움 사이즈도 하나 주문해야겠어요,
감사합니다 :)
text.JA:
転職先の会社に通勤バッグとして使おうと注文しました。
普段背が高くて荷物が多いタイプなので大きいバッグを好みます。
本当に低価格ブランドからハイブランドまで、市販されている大きいサイズのバッグは全部使ってみた気がします。
だからいつも全部満足できるバッグがなくて残念な気持ちも大きかった気がします。
まずCSがすごく親切で良かったです。最近デザイナーズブランド、小さいブランドが本当に多いですが、良い商品を売っていてもサービスの面で好感が持てないことが多いです。
でも待つ時間から商品を受け取るまでそういう不便さがなかったのも大きいです。
次に重さと革の質感でした。
家に持っている大きいバッグを全部出して比較してみました。このサイズでこの重さを実現するのは簡単じゃないです。しかも革を使ったバッグの場合はさらに!
そして革の質感です。素材選びをすごく上手にされたと思います。大きいバッグに荷物までたくさん入る場合、硬い革を使うと肩や擦れる腕にも負担がかかってシェイプが過剰に維持されるので
楽に掛けるのが簡単じゃありません。でも適度に柔らかい革を使いながらパターンをしっかり使って片側に偏ったり崩れたりしません、持ったり掛けたりした時は必要な範囲でシェイプが合います。
私も何かを作っていく人間なので、悩んで研究する作業を大事だと思っています。
本気で直接経験して悩んだ瞬間が詰まったバッグだと感じました。単にデザインが綺麗なユニークな商品を売っているのではなく、実用性を考えて配慮しようとした跡が見えます。
新しい良いブランドを知ることができて嬉しいです。
ミディアムサイズも一つ注文しないといけないですね、
ありがとうございます:)
text.EN:
I ordered it to use as a work bag for the company I'm planning to change jobs to.
I usually prefer big bags due to my height and lifting ability.
I think I've used all the large size bags on the market, from cheap brands to luxury brands.
That's why I always felt disappointed because I didn't have a bag that satisfied everything.
First of all, CS was very friendly and nice. There are a lot of designer brands and small brands these days, but even if they sell good products, their service is often not well-liked.
However, the waiting time and the fact that there was no such inconvenience until receiving the item also played a part.
Next was the weight and texture of the leather.
I took out all the big bags I had at home and compared them. It's not easy to get this kind of weight at this size. Even more so if the bag is made of leather!
And the leather texture. I think you made a very good choice. If you are going to fit a lot of luggage into a large bag, using hard leather will put a strain on your shoulder and arm when you carry it, and the shape will be maintained too much.
Not easy to tie comfortably. However, by using moderately soft leather and using the pattern wisely, it does not lean to one side or fall apart, and when lifted or worn, the shape matches the required line.
Since I am also a person who creates something, I consider thinking and researching important.
I thought it was a bag that contained the moments I had sincerely experienced and thought about. It appears that they are trying to consider practicality rather than simply selling unique products with pretty designs.
I'm glad to find a new good brand.
I need to order one in medium size too.
Thank you :)

text.KO:
저는 가방을 정말 정말 좋아하는 20대 후반 여성입니다! ㅎㅎ
그동안 인스타 광고나 피드에서
비마이연 헨느백
을 많이 봤었는데, 늘 “사봐야지, 사볼까?”만 하다가 사이즈가 조금 커서 고민만 했었어요.
그런데 드디어
미디움 사이즈
가 출시된 것을 보고 “이건 무조건 사야 한다!” 싶어서, 원픽 컬러인
카라멜 브라운 컬러
를 아침에 출근 준비하면서 장바구니에 넣어두고, 회사가서 점심 이후에 주문하려고 했거든요.
근데 인스타에 들어갔더니... 헉!
카라멜 브라운 컬러 품절
게시글이 올라와 있어서 정말 울적했어요 😭
다행히 2픽이었던
토프 모카 컬러
가 소량 남아 있다고 해서 바로 주문했고, 주인장님께 디엠도 보내서 컬러 확인도 했습니다. 카라멜 브라운 컬러도 궁금했지만, 결국 토프 모카 컬러로 결정!
배송은 정말
다음 날 바로 출발
해서 엄청 빨리 받을 수 있었고, 받자마자 박스를 열면서 “와!” 소리가 절로 나왔어요.
첫 번째 감탄 포인트는
컬러감
이에요. 사진에서 봤던 것보다 훨씬 더 예쁘고, 오묘하게 고급스러운 색감이 정말 실물에서는 더 살아있습니다.
개인적으로 카라멜 브라운 컬러보다
토프 모카를 선택하길 정말 잘했다
고 생각해요. 어디에나 잘 어울리고, 스타일링 걱정 없이 휘뚜루마뚜루 들 수 있는 컬러입니다.
데님 코디든 슬랙스 코디든... 반바지든 치마든... 사실 그냥 뭘 입든 잘 어울리는 그런 컬러감! 그리고 앞으로 다가올 계절인 가을 겨울에는 더 잘 어울릴 컬러감입니다!
그리고 무엇보다
수납력
이 대박이에요. 이미 게시물에서 수납력이 좋다고 봤지만, 실제로 사용해보니 예상보다 훨씬 더 편리합니다.
저는 이것저것 많이 넣고 다니는 편인데, 일반 가방이면 작은 물건들이 뒤섞여서 찾기 힘든데, 이 가방은
중간중간 구분된 공간
이 있어서 립스틱, 핸드크림 같은 작은 물건도 쉽게 찾을 수 있어요.
또한, 가방 바닥 부분이 스크래치나 더러움에 강하게 디자인되어 있어서, 바닥에 놓아도 안심이 되고 관리가 편리합니다. 세심하게 신경 쓴 부분이 느껴져서 너무 만족스러워요.
마지막으로, 가방 자체의
퀄리티와 마감

토프 모카 헨느백은 컬러, 디자인, 수납력, 퀄리티 모두 완벽한 가방

text.JA:
私はバッグが本当に本当に大好きな20代後半の女性です！笑
これまでInstagramの広告やフィードで
ビーマイヨンのヘンヌバッグ
をよく見かけていたのですが、いつも「買ってみようかな、どうしようかな」と思いながら、サイズが少し大きかったのでずっと迷っていました。
でも、ついに
ミディアムサイズ
が発売されたのを見て、「これは絶対に買わなきゃ！」と思い、イチオシの
キャラメルブラウンカラー
を朝、出勤の準備をしながらカートに入れておいて、会社に着いてお昼休みの後に注文しようと思っていたんです。
ところがInstagramを開いてみたら……えっ！
キャラメルブラウンが完売
という投稿が出ていて、本当にショックでした😭
幸い、第二候補だった
トープモカカラー
が少しだけ残っていると知って、すぐに注文しました。オーナーさんにもDMを送ってカラーの確認までしました。キャラメルブラウンも気になっていたのですが、結局トープモカに決定！
配送も本当に
翌日にすぐ発送
してくださって、すごく早く受け取ることができました。届いてすぐに箱を開けた瞬間、「わぁ！」と声が出ちゃいました。
最初に感動したポイントは、なんといっても
カラー
です。写真で見ていたよりもずっと綺麗で、絶妙で上品な色味が実物だとさらに引き立っています。
個人的には、キャラメルブラウンよりも
トープモカを選んで本当によかった
と思っています。どんな服にも合わせやすく、コーディネートに悩まず気軽に持てるカラーです。
デニムコーデでもスラックスコーデでも……ショートパンツでもスカートでも……本当に何を着てもよく合う、そんなカラーです！ そして、これからの季節である秋冬には、さらにぴったりなカラーだと思います！
そして何より、
収納力
がすごいです。投稿で収納力が高いことは知っていましたが、実際に使ってみると想像していた以上に便利でした。
私は普段からあれこれたくさん入れて持ち歩くタイプなのですが、普通のバッグだと小さなものが全部混ざってしまって、必要なものを探すのが大変ですよね。でもこのバッグには
仕切られた収納スペース
があるので、リップスティックやハンドクリームのような小さなものもすぐに見つけられます。
さらに、バッグの底部分も傷や汚れがつきにくいように作られているので、床に置くときも安心ですし、お手入れもしやすくて便利です。細かいところまで丁寧に考えて作られているのが感じられて、とても満足しています。
最後に、バッグ自体の
クオリティと仕上げ
も本当に素晴らしいです。素材はしっかりしているのに柔らかく、デザインはシンプルなのに洗練されていて、どんなスタイルにもよく合います。持って歩いていると、自然と目を引くような感じです😆
結論として、
トープモカのヘンヌバッグは、カラー、デザイン、収納力、クオリティのすべてが完璧なバッグ
です。写真より実物のほうがずっと可愛いという言葉、本当にその通りです。
私のようにバッグが大好きな方なら、きっと後悔せずに長く愛用できると思います。
実は私、ずっと欲しくて「買いたい、買いたい……」と思っていたプ0ダのバッグが一つあったんです。でも、そのバッグのお値段がなんと約500万ウォン……。
お給料がまだまだ少ない会社員の私には絶対に手が届かない価格だったので、泣く泣く諦めたのですが、
今となっては、あのバッグを買わなくて本当によかった……！ というか、買えなかったんですけどね。むしろラッキー！ いわゆるラッキービッキーです🍀
text.EN:
I’m a woman in my late 20s who really, really loves bags! Haha
I had been seeing the Bimayeon Henne Bag a lot in Instagram ads and feeds, and I kept thinking, “I should buy it. Should I give it a try?” But I always hesitated because the size seemed a little too big for me.
Then I finally saw that the Medium size had been released, and I immediately thought, “I absolutely have to get this!” So I put my first-choice color, Caramel Brown, into my cart while getting ready for work that morning, planning to place the order after lunch once I got to the office.
But then I opened Instagram and... oh no!
There was a post saying that the Caramel Brown color was sold out, and I was honestly so disappointed😭
Luckily, I found out that my second choice, Taupe Mocha, was still available in limited quantities, so I ordered it right away. I even sent the owner a DM to confirm the color. I was still curious about Caramel Brown, but in the end, I chose Taupe Mocha!
It was shipped the very next day, so I received it incredibly quickly. As soon as it arrived, I opened the box and naturally let out a “Wow!”
The first thing that impressed me was the
color.
It was much prettier in person than it looked in the photos, and the subtle yet sophisticated color really comes alive in person.
Personally, I’m really glad I chose Taupe Mocha instead of Caramel Brown. It goes well with just about anything, and it’s the kind of color you can throw on effortlessly without worrying about styling.
Whether it’s a denim outfit or a slacks outfit... shorts or a skirt... honestly, it’s the kind of color that looks good with pretty much anything you wear! And I think it’ll be even more perfect for the upcoming fall and winter seasons!
And above all,
the storage capacity
is amazing. I had already seen in the posts that it had great storage, but after actually using it, it was much more convenient than I expected.
I tend to carry a lot of little things with me, and in a regular bag, small items can get mixed together and become difficult to find. But this bag has
separate compartments throughout,
so even small things like lipstick and hand cream are easy to find.
The bottom of the bag is also designed to resist scratches and dirt, so I can put it down without worrying, and it’s easy to keep clean. I’m really satisfied because I can tell how much attention was paid to all the little details.
Lastly, the bag’s
quality and craftsmanship
are also excellent. The material is sturdy yet soft, and the design is simple but sophisticated, so it goes well with just about anything. It’s the kind of bag that naturally catches people’s attention when you carry it😆
In conclusion,
the Taupe Mocha Henne Bag is perfect in every way—color, design, storage capacity, and quality.
The saying that it looks even prettier in person than in photos is absolutely true.
For anyone who loves bags as much as I do, I think this is something you can own without any regrets.
Actually, there was a bag from P0DA that I really, really wanted. I kept thinking, “I want to buy it, I want to buy it...” but that bag cost a whopping 5 million won.
As an office worker living on a modest salary, that was a price I could never afford, so I eventually gave up on it.
Now I’m actually glad I didn’t buy that bag... (Well, technically I couldn’t afford it, haha. But honestly, even better! Lucky Vicky!)

text.KO:
“예쁨에 수납력까지 챙긴 가방, 이건 반칙 아닌가요?”
요즘 데일리백 고를 때 가장 중요한 건 단연 수납력. 그런데 예쁘기까지 하면? 그건 그냥 운명입니다.
이 가방, 처음엔 디자인에 반해서 샀는데 쓰면 쓸수록 실용성에 더 반하게 되는 마법이 있어요.
수납력: 작은 듯 보이지만 내부가 알차게 구성되어 있어서 지갑, 핸드폰, 파우치, 보조배터리, 텀블러까지 쏙쏙 들어가요.
꿀팁까진 아니지만 텀블러자리에 양산넣으면 딱이더라구요!
디자인: 군더더기 없이 깔끔하면서도 포인트 지갑까지 어떤 룩에도 찰떡.
착용감: 어깨에 착 감기는 스트랩, 오래 들어도 부담 없어요.
활용도: 출근룩에도, 주말 나들이에도, 심지어 여행에도 찰떡궁합.
가방 하나로 스타일도 살리고, 짐도 깔끔하게 정리하고 싶다면 이건 진심 추천템.
“예쁘기만 한 가방은 이제 못 써요. 예쁘고 똑똑한 가방이 대세!”
text.JA:
「可愛さに収納力まで備えたバッグ、これって反則じゃないですか?」
最近デイリーバッグを選ぶ時、一番大事なのは断然収納力。でもそれに加えて可愛かったら?それはもう運命です。
このバッグ、最初はデザインに惚れて買ったんですが、使えば使うほど実用性にもっと惚れてしまう魔法があります。
収納力: 小さく見えますが中がしっかり構成されていて、財布、スマホ、ポーチ、モバイルバッテリー、タンブラーまですっぽり入ります。
裏技というほどではないですが、タンブラーの位置に日傘を入れるとちょうどいいです!
デザイン: 無駄がなくすっきりしているのに、ポイントになるウォレットまでどんなスタイルにもぴったり。
着け心地: 肩にぴったりフィットするストラップ、長く持っても負担がありません。
活用度: 出勤スタイルにも、週末のお出かけにも、旅行にもぴったり。
バッグ一つでスタイルも決めて、荷物もすっきり整理したいならこれは本当におすすめです。
「可愛いだけのバッグはもう使えません。可愛くて賢いバッグが主流です!」
text.EN:
“A bag that is both pretty and has storage capacity. Isn’t this against the law?”
These days, the most important thing when choosing a daily bag is definitely storage capacity. But what if it’s pretty? It's just fate.
I bought this bag because I fell in love with its design at first, but the more I use it, the more I fall in love with its practicality.
Storage capacity: It may seem small, but the interior is well-organized, so it can easily fit a wallet, cell phone, pouch, auxiliary battery, and even a tumbler.
It's not a great tip, but putting a parasol in the tumbler's place is perfect!
Design: Simple and clean, perfect for any look, including a point wallet.
Comfort: The strap fits comfortably on the shoulder, so it doesn't feel burdensome even if you wear it for a long time.
Usability: Perfect for work wear, weekend outings, and even travel.
If you want to maintain style and organize your luggage neatly with just one bag, this is a truly recommended item.
“I can no longer use bags that are just pretty. Pretty and smart bags are the trend!”

text.JA:
私はミディアムバッグの持ち手にDiorオブリークのスカーフを巻いてみました!
私は割とモノトーンできちんとした服装をよくするタイプなんですが、ちょうどこのバッグにスカーフを巻いたらすごく綺麗だろうなと思いました!
確かに思っていた通りすごく高級感があって綺麗です🖤
それに会社員ですが勉強もしているのでiPadは必須で持ち歩くんですが、このバッグにiPad(11インチ)も入れられて
きちんとした印象と実用性両方叶えられました:)
以前はiPadを入れるために荷物多め用の大きいバッグを掛けて歩いていたんです(涙涙) そうすると自分のスタイルも決まらず不便でした...
でも今はyyeonのバッグがあって本当に...本当に自分が楽になって高級感が出た気がします(涙)
そしてyyeonでの購入を迷わなかったもう一つの理由は
私の名前にも「연」が入っていて、yyeonの刻印の感じがすごく良かったです😆
それにすごく高級感のある革のハンドバッグにiPadまで入る実用性があって本当に悩み1つもせずすぐ購入しました!!!
私みたいにきちんとしたスタイルが好きでiPadを必ず持ち歩く会社員の方がいたら、このバッグをすごく気に入ると思います🖤🖤🖤
綺麗に大切に持ち歩きます~!
text.EN:
I wrapped a Dior oblique scarf around the handle of a medium bag!
I tend to wear a lot of neutral-colored, neat looks, but I thought it would look really pretty if I wrapped a scarf around this bag!
It's definitely as luxurious and pretty as I thought 🖤
Also, I am an office worker, but I study, so I carry an iPad with me as a necessity, and I can also fit an iPad (11 inches) in this bag.
I was able to achieve both neatness and practicality :)
Before that, I had to carry something big like a someone who carries a lot of things's bag to put my iPad in. That didn't suit my look and was uncomfortable...
But now that I have the Bimayeon bag... I really feel more comfortable and luxurious ㅠㅡㅠ
And another reason why I did not hesitate to purchase from Bmyeyeon
My name also has ‘yeon’ in it, so I really liked the engraving of yyeon 😆
Plus, it was so luxurious and practical that it could even fit an iPad, so I bought it right away without even thinking about it!!!
If you are an office worker like me who likes a neat look and always carries an iPad with you, I think you will really like this bag🖤🖤🖤
I’ll carry it around nicely!

text.KO: 우연히 인스타 광고로 마주한 yyeon, 사실 가방에 별로 관심이 없는 편인데 이 가방은 보자마자 너무 예뻐서 헉! 했어요. 평소 인터넷 구매는 실패한 적이 많아 처음에도 정말 많은 고민을 했답니다. 하지만 고민은 역시 배송만 늦출 뿐.. 오랜 고민 끝에 구매하게 되었고, 이제는 어떠한 명품가방 보다도 yyeon, 제품이 훨씬 만족스러워요🤍 작지만 정말 알찬 구성을 갖추고 있고, 편리성은 물론 어디에도 메기 딱 좋아요. 들고 나가면 친구들이 어디서 샀냐고 꼭 물어본답니다. 공식홈이 생기기 전 DM으로 구입하기 시작해서 어느새 yyeon, 가방은 3개가 되었네요!ㅎㅎ 특히나 정말 여자여자한 버터베이지 완전 강추해요💛
text.JA: 偶然インスタの広告で出会ったyyeon、実はバッグにあまり興味がないほうなんですが、このバッグは見た瞬間すごく綺麗でハッとしました!普段ネットショッピングで失敗することが多いので、最初はすごく悩みました。でも悩みは結局配送を遅らせるだけ..長い間悩んだ末に購入することになり、今ではどんなハイブランドバッグよりもyyeonの商品のほうがずっと満足しています🤍小さいけど本当にしっかりした構成になっていて、便利さはもちろん、どこにでも合わせやすいです。持って出かけると友達がどこで買ったのか必ず聞いてきます。公式ホームページができる前からDMで購入し始めて、いつの間にかyyeonのバッグは3個になりました!笑 特に本当に女性らしいバターベージュを完全におすすめします💛
text.EN: I met yyeon by chance through an Instagram ad. Actually, I'm not that interested in bags, but this bag was so pretty that I gasped as soon as I saw it! i did it. I had many failed online purchases, so I had a lot of concerns at first. But worrying only delays delivery... After much thought, I decided to buy it, and now I am much more satisfied with yyeon's product than with any other luxury bag🤍 Although it is small, it has a really solid composition, and is not only convenient, but also perfect for carrying anywhere. Whenever I take it out, my friends always ask where I bought it. I started purchasing through DM before the official website was created, and before I knew it, I had 3 yyeon bags! Haha, I especially highly recommend the really girly Butter Beige color💛

I expected it, but the bag itself is a bit heavy.

It would have been many times prettier if the brand wasn't engraved, but that part is a bit disappointing.

내부 구성을 보고 넘 맘에 들어 구매하게 되었어요
깊이가 있어 제품이 보이지도 않고
아이패드 넣는 공간이 따로 포켓으로 되어 있어
좋았어요
아이패드, 다이어리, 파우치, 필기구, 넣어도 충분히
수납공간이 되는 백이라서 넘 맘에 들어요
특히 텀블러 넣는 공간이 있어 유용하게 사용하고 있어요
보부상백 중 고급스러운 디자인을 찾기가 어려웠는데
넘 고급스럽고 핏이 각이 딱 잡혀서  좋고
내부구성까지 맘에 들어 직장인 데일리백으로
잘 사용하고 있어요🥰
text.JA:
普段から大容量バッグを探している中
インスタで知ったyyeon
ラッキーですよね〜🍀
仕事柄iPadが必須!
大容量バッグでありながら高級感のあるデザインを探していたんですが
内部の構成を見てすごく気に入って購入することになりました
深さがあって中身が見えないですし
iPadを入れるスペースが別にポケットになっていて良かったです
iPad、手帳、ポーチ、筆記用具、入れても十分
収納できるバッグなのですごく気に入っています
特にタンブラーを入れるスペースがあって便利に使っています
大容量バッグの中で高級感のあるデザインを見つけるのが難しかったんですが
すごく高級感があってフォルムもかっちりしていて良いですし
内部の構成まで気に入って社会人のデイリーバッグとして
愛用しています🥰
text.EN:
I was looking for a bag for someone who carries a lot of things.
I met yyeon through Instagram
It's Lucky Vicky~🍀
iPad is essential for my job!
I was looking for a sophisticated design with plenty of storage.
After seeing the interior design, I really liked it so I bought it.
It's so deep that you can't even see the product.
There is a separate pocket for the iPad.
It was good
Enough to fit iPad, diary, pouch, writing utensil, etc.
I really like this bag because it has storage space.
It is especially useful as there is a space for a tumbler.
It was difficult to find a luxurious design among bags with lots of storage.
It's very luxurious and the fit is perfect.
I like the interior design, making it a daily bag for office workers.
I've been using it a lot🥰

text.KO: 저는 가방 주문하면 아예 스트랩 미포함이라는 줄 알고 긴 거 짧은 거 다 주문했는데 ㅋㅋ기본 끈이 있더라고요ㅋㅋ 그래도 체인 줄이 훨씬 예쁩니다. 정장처럼 갖춰 입는 날은 크로스는 덜 단정해 보여서 숄더 끈도 같이 주문했습니다!
text.JA: バッグを注文したら、ストラップが最初から付いていないものだと思って長いのも短いのも全部注文したんですが、笑 基本のストラップがちゃんと付いていました笑 それでもチェーンストラップのほうがずっと綺麗です。きちんとした服装をする日はクロスだと少しだらしなく見えるので、ショルダーストラップも一緒に注文しました!
text.EN: When I ordered a bag, I thought the strap would not be included, so I ordered both the long and short ones, but it had a standard strap. Still, the chain strap is much prettier. On days when I wear it like a suit, a crossbody bag looks less neat, so I also ordered a shoulder strap!

text.KO: 크로스 없으면 좀 불편해하는 스타일이라 체인 추가했어요 저는 가방 주문하면 아예 스트랩 미포함이라는 줄 알고 긴 거 짧은 거 다 주문했는데 ㅋㅋ기본 끈이 있더라고요ㅋㅋ 그래도 체인 줄이 훨씬 예쁩니다. 별도로 줄을 더 늘릴 수는 없어서 옷을 두껍게 입거나 덩치가 있으신 분들에게는 크로스로 매기 좀 애매하게 짧아 보일 수 있을 거 같아요 참고
text.JA: クロスがないとちょっと不便に感じるタイプなのでチェーンを追加しました。バッグを注文するとストラップが最初から付いていないものだと思って長いのも短いのも全部注文したんですが笑 基本のストラップがちゃんとありました笑 それでもチェーンストラップのほうがずっと綺麗です。別途ストラップを伸ばすことはできないので、厚着をする方や体格の大きい方にはクロスで斜め掛けするには少し中途半端に短く見えるかもしれません、ご参考までに
text.EN: I added a chain because it's a style that's a bit uncomfortable without a cross. I knew that when I ordered a bag, the strap wouldn't be included, so I ordered both the long and short ones, but it came with a standard strap. Still, the chain line is much prettier. Note that the string cannot be extended separately, so for people who wear thick clothes or are large, tying it crosswise may look a bit short.

text.KO:
생각한 거 보다 더 너무 작아서 살짝 당황하긴 했는데
아코디언처럼 늘릴 수 있어서 괜찮을 거 같아요
색감도 너무 쨍하거나 어둡지 않아서 여름에도 크게 더워 보이지 않을 거 같아서 만족해요!
다만 생각보다 금장장식 부분이 스크레치도 있고
엄-청 고급지다는 느낌은 안 드네요 ㅠ ㅠ 그래도 예쁘니깐😉
text.JA:
思っていたよりさらに小さくて少し戸惑いましたが
アコーディオンのように広げられるので大丈夫そうです
色味も派手すぎず暗すぎずなので、夏でも暑苦しく見えなさそうで満足しています!
ただ思ったより金具の部分に傷があって
すごーく高級感があるという感じはしません(涙) それでも綺麗なので😉
text.EN:
I was a little taken aback because it was smaller than I thought.
I think it will be okay because it can be stretched like an accordion.
I'm satisfied because the color isn't too bright or dark, so it won't look too hot even in the summer!
However, there are some scratches on the gold decoration than expected.
It doesn't feel very luxurious ㅠ ㅠ but it's still pretty😉

text.KO: 생각보다 빠른 배송에 기분이 너무 좋았습니다. 두근거리는 마음으로 포장을 풀자마자 보이는 yyeon, 마크와 에코백 재질의 파우치에 들어있는 가방을 보니 설레더라구요~ 파우치를 여니 광이나면서도 고급스러운 브라운색의 가방이 눈에 들어왔어요! 색깔 고민을 너무 많이 했었는데 쌀쌀해진 요즘 계절에 딱이라는 생각이 들어 뿌듯했답니다! 역시 내 선택은 옳았어.. 안감이 파란색으로 되어있는데 이 또한 너무 예쁜 색이네요~ 당장 들고 나갈 곳은 없지만 새 가방이니 물건을 한번 옮겨 담아보았어요~ 아니 가방은 작고 귀여운 사이즈인데 물건 들어가는 양 실화에요? 저 보부상 재질 인간이라 살짝 걱정했는데 지갑 폰 차키 보조배터리 립3개 핸드크림 쿠션 버즈 장바구니 미스트까지 몽땅 들어갑니다 너무 행복해요🥺 이번 주말 예쁘게 들고 외출해보려구요~ 이 가격에 이런 제품이라니 너무 만족스러워요! 아끼면서 오래오래 사용할게요. 감사합니다!
text.JA: 思ったより速い配送ですごく嬉しかったです。ワクワクしながら包みを開けるとすぐに見えたyyeonのマークと、エコバッグ素材のポーチに入ったバッグを見て胸が高鳴りました〜 ポーチを開けると、艶のある高級感のあるブラウンのバッグが目に入りました!色をすごく悩んだんですが、肌寒くなってきた最近の季節にぴったりだと思って誇らしかったです!やっぱり私の選択は正しかった.. 裏地が青色になっているんですが、これもすごく綺麗な色ですね〜 今すぐ持って出かける予定はないですが、新しいバッグなので一度荷物を移し替えてみました〜 いや、バッグは小さくて可愛いサイズなのに、入る量が本当にすごいんです。私はもともと荷物が多いタイプなので少し心配だったんですが、財布、スマホ、車の鍵、モバイルバッテリー、リップ3本、ハンドクリーム、クッション、イヤホン、エコバッグ、ミストまで全部入ります。すごく幸せです🥺 今週末綺麗に持って出かけてみようと思います〜 この価格でこんな商品だなんてすごく満足です!大切に長く使います。ありがとうございます!
text.EN: I was very happy with the delivery faster than expected. As soon as I unpacked it with a pounding heart, I was excited to see the yyeon mark and the bag in an eco-bag material pouch. When I opened the pouch, a shiny yet luxurious brown bag caught my eye! I thought too much about the color, but I was happy because I thought it was perfect for the chilly weather these days! As expected, my choice was right... The lining is blue, which is also a very pretty color. I don't have anywhere to take it out right now, but since it's a new bag, I tried moving things around. No, the bag is small and cute, but is it true that it fits a lot of things? I was a little worried because I'm a human being, but everything goes in my wallet, phone, car key, auxiliary battery, 3 lipsticks, hand cream, cushion, buzz, shopping cart mist. I'm so happy🥺 I'm going to go out looking pretty this weekend~ I'm very satisfied with this product at this price! I will cherish it and use it for a long time. thank you!

text.KO:
장점
1. 약간 크랙같은 무늬에 광택도 너무 예쁘고 가방 진짜 가벼워요.
2. 평소에 출퇴근할 때 들고다니는거 다 들어가요(쿠션,립3,코인월렛,에어팟,핸드크림,기름종이,블러셔,아이라이너,브로우 등) 심지어 폰이 프로맥스인데 저상태에서 맥스 들어가도 위에 공간 남아서 다른거 더 넣을 수 있겠어요!
3. 바닥에 가죽 안닿게 찡같은거 박혀있는거 너무 좋아요
단점
1. 내부 똑딱이 수납포켓이 한손으로 닫고 열 수가 없어요.. 가방 무게보다 여는 힘이 더 세서 똑딱이 열려다 가방 다 찌그러질 것 같아요. 제가 따로 자석을 붙일까 고민중입니다... 열고 쓰기엔 뚜껑이 덜렁거려서 불편해요.
2. 크로스 스트랩이 생각보다 짧아요! 가장 끄크머리에 착용했는데 키158 기준 아랫배 언저리에 걸쳐져 있어서 개인적으로 조금 여닫고 쓰기 불편할거같아요!
text.JA:
良い点
1. 少しクラックのような柄と光沢がすごく綺麗で、バッグが本当に軽いです。
2. 普段出勤・退勤時に持ち歩くものが全部入ります（クッション、リップ3本、コインウォレット、AirPods、ハンドクリーム、あぶらとり紙、チーク、アイライナー、アイブロウなど）スマホがPro Maxなんですが、その状態でMaxを入れてもまだ上にスペースが余って他のものも入れられそうです!
3. 底が革に直接触れないように鋲のようなものが付いているのがすごくいいです
残念な点
1. 内側のスナップボタン式の収納ポケットが片手で開け閉めできません..バッグの重さより開ける力のほうが強くて、開けようとするとバッグ全体が潰れそうになります。自分で別に磁石を付けようか悩んでいます...開けたまま使うには蓋がぐらぐらして不便です。
2. クロスストラップが思ったより短いです!一番端の穴で着けたんですが、身長158cm基準でお腹の下あたりに来るので、個人的には少し開け閉めしにくいと思います!
text.EN:
Advantages
1. It has a slightly crack-like pattern, has a very pretty gloss, and the bag is really light.
2. It contains everything I usually carry when commuting (cushion, lip 3, coin wallet, Airpods, hand cream, wax paper, blusher, eyeliner, brows, etc.) Even though my phone is a Pro Max, even if I put it in the Max in that state, there will still be space on top so I can put more things in it!
3. I really like that there is something like a stick on the floor that doesn't touch the leather.
Cons
1. The internal snap storage pocket cannot be closed and opened with one hand. The opening force is stronger than the weight of the bag, so I think the bag will be crushed when it snaps open. I'm contemplating whether to attach a separate magnet... The lid is shaky and inconvenient to open and use.
2. The cross strap is shorter than I thought! I wore it on the shortest part of my head, but since I am 158cm tall, it hangs around my lower abdomen, so I personally think it would be a bit uncomfortable to open and close!

text.KO: 드뎌 오늘 받았어요. 색깔은 상상했던 그대로. 여리여리 레몬색입니다. 근데 사이즈는 생각보다 작아서,... 책한권 넣어보려했는데 그건 불가능하네요ㅎㅎ 갖고 다니는 자질구레한 소품들은 구획별로 잘 정리되네요. 가방 가볍고, 가죽질도 좋구..항상 어두운색 가방만 들고 다녔는데 화사하게 요 가방 잘 들고 다닐께요. 이쁜 가방 만드시느라 고생많으셨어요! 감사합니다!
text.JA: やっと今日受け取りました。色は想像していた通りです。柔らかいレモン色です。でもサイズは思ったより小さくて…本を1冊入れてみようとしたんですが、それは無理でした笑 持ち歩く細々した小物は区画ごとにちゃんと整理できます。バッグは軽くて革の質感も良くて..いつも暗い色のバッグばかり持ち歩いていたんですが、これからは明るくこのバッグを持ち歩きます。可愛いバッグを作るのに苦労されたと思います!ありがとうございます!
text.EN: I finally received it today. The color was just as I imagined. It is a soft lemon color. But the size is smaller than I thought... I tried to put a book in it, but that was impossible haha. The small items I carry around are well organized by section. The bag is light and the leather quality is good... I always carried dark colored bags, but I will carry this bright bag. Thank you for your hard work making this pretty bag! thank you!

text.JA:
ピンポーン!!宅配便が届きました。
今日…会社で連絡を受けて、どれだけそわそわしていたか😅
光の速さで定時退勤して宅配便からオープン〜!!!
うわ......バターイエロー.........こんな色を作り出すなんて!!!!!!!
実物のほうがずっと綺麗です!!!カメラに収まりきらない....色です。
本当に..........このファンディングを逃さなかった自分を褒めたいです☺️☺️
まず、私の出勤スタイルの8割はジーンズなんですが、ジーンズによく合うバッグです。トートバッグとしてもクロスバッグとしても両方綺麗です笑
そしてバッグの収納は..長財布、ウェットティッシュ、口紅、コンパクト、車の鍵まで入ります。長財布じゃない財布を使えばもっとたくさん入れられそうです〜
今は完全に大満足です!!
大きいサイズバージョンも作ってください☺️☺️
明日から頑張って持ち歩いてみます😉
p.s. 旦那に内緒で購入したんですが;;;;
重さも軽くて色も綺麗だと褒めてくれました😆😆
text.EN:
Ding-dong!! The delivery has arrived.
Today... when I got the delivery notification at work, I was practically bouncing in my seat from excitement😅
I left work right on time at the speed of light and opened the package as soon as I got home~!!!
Wow...... Butter Yellow......... How did they even create a color like this!!!!!!!
It’s even more beautiful in person!!! It’s one of those colors that just doesn’t come through on camera.
Honestly.......... I have to give myself credit for not missing this funding campaign☺️☺️
First of all, about 80% of my work outfits are jeans, and this bag goes so well with denim. It looks beautiful both as a tote bag and as a crossbody bag haha.
And the storage... it fits a long wallet, wet tissues, lipstick, a compact, and even my car keys. If you use a smaller wallet instead of a long wallet, I think you could fit even more~
I’m completely satisfied with it right now!!
Please make a larger version too☺️☺️
I’m going to carry it everywhere starting tomorrow😉
p.s. I bought it secretly without telling my husband;;;;
But he even complimented me, saying that it’s lightweight and the color is really pretty😆😆

text.EN:

text.KO: 은은한 유광에 크랙이 너무 예뻐요. 팩트랑 립스틱 따로 넣을 공간도 있고 보부상인데 이것저것 다 넣어도 들어가서 좋아요. 꽉 채워넣으면 파우치 부분 똑딱이 닫기가 어려운 점과 실밥 마감 부분이 조금씩 튀어나온 부분이 아쉽긴 합니다. 그래도 데일리로 들고다닐 수 있게 심플한데 예쁘고 이만큼 들어가는 가방 찾기 어려울 것 같아서 펀딩하길 잘 한 것 같아요‎ ´ސު｀
text.JA: 控えめな艶とクラック柄がすごく綺麗です。コンパクトとリップを別々に入れられるスペースもあって、荷物が多いタイプなんですがあれこれ全部入って良いです。ぎっしり詰めるとポーチ部分のスナップボタンが閉めにくい点と、縫い糸の仕上げ部分が少しずつ飛び出している点は残念ではあります。それでもデイリーに持ち歩けるくらいシンプルなのに綺麗で、これだけ入るバッグを見つけるのは難しそうなので、ファンディングして良かったと思います
text.EN: The cracks in the subtle gloss are so pretty. There's space to put the pact and lipstick separately, and even though it's a comforter box, it's nice to be able to put everything in there. It's unfortunate that it's difficult to close the pouch when it's fully filled, and that the seam closure part sticks out a little. Still, I think it was a good idea to fund it because I thought it would be difficult to find a simple but pretty bag that fits this much so that I can carry it every day.

text.JA:
受け取る前から期待でドキドキしていたんですが、受け取ってさらに満足しています。柔らかい革の素材、なめらかな質感、光によって変わる艶感、最後の仕上げまで!!
すごく~綺麗で高級感のあるバッグです。写真ではこの高級感を全部表現しきれていないと思います
実物のほうが本当に本当にずっと綺麗です
リップを入れる仕切りが3つもあって、本当にバッグの中であちこち転がらないように収納できます
リップ、下地、ポイントカラー、リップバーム、この3つを持ち歩いているんですが、本当にちょうどいいです
ポーチも必ず持ち歩いていたんですが、ポーチの中でごちゃごちゃ混ざってさらに探しにくいことが多かったです
でもこのバッグ一つであちこちにサッとそれぞれの場所に入れてくれるので、収納にむしろ余裕があります。不思議です
配送が届いてすぐバッグに荷物を移し替えました
明日から私のデイリーバッグです笑 良いバッグをこれからもたくさんたくさん作ってください。ありがとうございます
text.EN:
I was excited and nervous before receiving it, but I was even more satisfied after receiving it. Soft leather material, smooth texture, gloss that changes depending on the light, and even the final finish!!
It's such a classy bag. I don't think photos can capture all of this luxurious bag.
It's so much prettier in real life
There are three compartments for lipstick, so you can store them without them rolling around in your bag.
I carry a base lipstick, a point-color lipstick, and a lip balm, and the three lipstick slots are perfect for them.
I also carried a pouch with me, but there were many times when it was difficult to find because it was all mixed up inside the pouch.
But it's amazing that since I can put everything neatly in its designated place, there's actually still plenty of room left.
As soon as it was delivered, I immediately moved the bag.
This will be my daily bag starting tomorrow haha. Please make more great bags in the future. Thank you.

text.JA:

text.EN:
★Thank you very much for the faster delivery than expected★
The quantity must have been enormous, but the seller worked really hard.
As soon as I received it, I took hundreds of millions of photos, but why am I only able to attach five?ㅠI'm trying to narrow it down...
-First of all, the shine and texture of the bag are crazy.
If you polish the bag incorrectly, it will look cheap.
The subtle cracks on this are really classy...
I'm a blue fan, so of course I went in to buy only blue, but why did yellow seem to be the main color and tempt me;; I couldn't resist and bought them both.
Blue's mouth hurts when she talks, but of course she's pretty.
Butter yellow... it's not really the typical butter yellow, it's a luxurious color that has about 0.5 drops of green and is hard to describe in words. This is really difficult.
Since I bought it in the summer, I naturally bought blue and yellow, but now that I think about it, delivery comes in the fall?
Every time they posted new news, I saw black and brown flashes while looking at the detailed cuts,,,
Butter yellow is the best so I have no regrets at all.
-And the storage capacity is really...is this a mini bag?
As soon as it was delivered, I immediately opened it and put all my belongings in the bag.
Glasses holder, 3 lipsticks, solid perfume, charger, cushion, card wallet, pins fit comfortably ^^
I always open the lipstick cap in my bag and move around freely, and it took me a year to find lip balm, but that doesn't happen anymore. I'm so happy^__^♡
-Yomul point pocket,,,★
By the way, when I bought it, my eyes were wandering so I bought it in a hurry, so I didn't actually look at the details page.
But what is this hidden pocket...? It's perfect if you put a sanitary pad in it...?
I must be really crazy. Since it is a three-dimensional pocket, I think it will be enough to fit two or three sanitary pads.
The details are really crazy.
And I think it would be perfect to put the four pieces of my life in the back storage without getting them wrinkled. It's perfect, really^^
Even the engraving on the back of the bag is so emotional and pretty that even if you carry it regardless of whether it is front or back, you won't know which side is the front hee hee.
Seasonality? I don't know about that, but I'll take it to the wedding this week. Thank you seller
And I'm sorry, but why don't you try making another bag too? I am ready to give any amount of money.

text.KO: 색이 오묘해서 더 마음에 들어요. 보통 가방 광고할 때 외부 디자인만 여러 컷 보여주고 내부 수납공간 사진은 별로 없고 보기 어렵던데, 수납 공간이 여유로워 보이고 색상 진짜 진짜 고민하다 골랐는데 엄청 취향 저격.  내부 천 색상도 이렇게 포인트로 심심하지 않고 좋아요.  특유의 새 제품 냄새가 심하긴 한데 금방 빠지겟죠 . 이렇게 밝은 색상의 가방은 처음이라 청바지나 검정의류에 염색될까 좀 조심스러워요. 내년 봄에 들껀데 놓치면 너무너무 아쉬울거 같아서 질렀는데....후회없어요🤣 후기 보다보니 갈색도 사계절 무난하게 들거 같아서 눈에 밟힙니다...
text.JA: 色が絶妙でさらに気に入っています。普通バッグの広告って外側のデザインばかり何カットも見せて内部の収納スペースの写真はあまりなくて見づらいんですが、収納スペースにゆとりがありそうで、色も本当に本当に悩んで選んだんですがすごく好みにぴったりです。内部の生地の色もこうやってポイントになっていて単調じゃなくていいです。独特の新品の匂いがかなりしますが、すぐ抜けると思います。こんなに明るい色のバッグは初めてなので、ジーンズや黒い服に色移りしないか少し気を使います。来年の春に持とうと思っているんですが、逃すとすごくすごく残念そうなので思い切って買いました....後悔していません🤣 レビューを見ていたら茶色も一年中無難に持てそうで気になっています...
text.EN: I like it more because the color is subtle. Usually, when advertising a bag, only several shots of the exterior design are shown and there are not many photos of the interior storage space, which is hard to see, but the storage space looks spacious and I really thought about the color before choosing it, but it really suits my taste.  The interior fabric color is also nice and not boring.  It has a strong new product smell, but it will go away quickly. This is my first time with a bag in such a bright color, so I'm a little worried that it might stain my jeans or black clothes. I bought it next spring because I thought it would be really disappointing if I missed it... but I don't regret it🤣 After reading the reviews, I thought the brown color would be suitable all year round, so it caught my eye...

パッケージからこだわりが感じられて高級感があって,,パッケージを見て深呼吸ふぅふぅしてから開けたんですが、本当に見た目からして上品です..こんなに安っぽさが一切なくてなめらかなのか、艶ありなので少し心配していたんですが無駄な心配だったじゃないですか?!なんでスカイブルーとブラックで悩んでブラックだけ買ったんでしょうか?私は一体なんでそんな無駄な悩みをしたんでしょうか?🥹刻印もすごく洗練されて入っていて内部の収納スペースが多いのでインナーバッグ好きな私にぴったりです!カジュアルにもフォーマルにもよく合ってなにより軽くて..!私は本当に一体なんで悩んでブラック一つだけ買ったんでしょうか!!!!過去の自分反省しろ🤬クロスストラップもこだわりが感じられてすごくて、フックって言うんですか?それさえもペンダントみたいにキラキラして綺麗です(涙)実は購入する時有名な低価格ブランドでもないしちょっと高いかな..と思ったんですが、受け取ってみるとこの金額でこのクオリティ、このデザイン、この重さなら安かったです本当にコスパ最高です言うまでもありません本当にアーリーバード価格で2つ買えばよかった、うわーん,,😭私はもうyyeonブランドの熱狂的なファンになりました。yyeonバッグのシーズン2も出てほしいです。このバッグもこんなに綺麗で高級感があってどこにでも合ってコスパ最高なのに、アップグレードされたシーズン2が出たらそれはまたどれだけすごいでしょうか,,Wadizが改善点を教えてほしいと言うので強いて挙げるなら、内部の生地をもう少し目立たない、もう少しトーンダウンした色味で、コットンじゃなくてもう少しシルキーな質感の素材だったらもっと洗練された感じになったんじゃないかと思います。でも今のままでもすごくすごくいいです -綺麗なバッグを受け取って気分の良い購入者より
text.EN:
yyeon's long-awaited baby bag has finally arrived!! It's no secret that I was waiting in front of the front door because I was so excited that the delivery man was coming😉
The tee that was put into the package was so luxurious, I took a deep breath when I saw the package and opened it, and it was really pretty from the color on.. I was a little worried because it didn't look cheap at all and it was smooth and glossy, but it was a useless worry, right?! Why did I decide between sky blue and black but only bought black? Why on earth did I worry about such unnecessary things?🥹 The engraving is so sophisticated and there's a lot of internal storage space, so it's perfect for me, who likes inner bags! It goes well with both casual and formal wear, and above all, it's lightweight! Why on earth did I even bother to buy just the black one!!!! Reflect on my past self 🤬 Is it called a loop because it shows that you put too much care into the cross strap? Even that sparkles and is pretty like a pendant. In fact, when I bought it, I wondered if it was expensive since it wasn't a famous low-cost brand. But when I received it, it was cheap for this price, this quality, this design, this weight. It's really the best value for money. What can I say, I should have bought two for the early bird price,,😭 I'm already a big fan of the yeonn brand. I wish Season 2 of the Yeonn bag would come out as well. This bag is this pretty, looks busty, and is the best value for money. How amazing would it be if an upgraded Season 2 comes out? Wadiz asked me to tell them what they can improve, but if I had to point out, I think it would have been much more sophisticated if the inner fabric had been in a more toned-down color that wasn't too eye-catching and a silkier material than cotton. But it's still really good. - Posted by a happy buyer who received a pretty bag

text.JA:
本当に...こんなに満足できるなんて(涙) 私、本当に荷物が多いタイプなんです...いつもバッグを買っても気に入らなくて買っては買い直して...でもやっと定着アイテムを見つけました。
最初にファンディングした時からこれは自分のだ!と思ったんですが、ここまで気に入るとは思いませんでした(涙) まず色味!!!素材!!!本当にあり得ないくらい高級感があって気に入っています!!!ちょうど自分が欲しかった色そのままです。本当に驚いたのは裏地です!色もすごく綺麗で、高級感があって...しかもすごくしっかりしています。内も外も両方!!私みたいなおっちょこちょいはバッグに何か付けたり落としたり傷つけたりするんですが、心配いりません!縫製もすごくしっかりしています。
そしてこのバッグのハイライト...収納力!!!私はいつもポーチを3つくらい持ち歩くんです。種類別に分けているんですが...それだといつもバッグがパンパンになっていたんですが、ポーチを全部家に置いて出てきました。え、こんなに入るの?ってくらいどんどん入ります笑笑笑笑 しかも余裕があります笑笑笑笑笑 本当にワクワクします本当に(涙)
私、もうバッグはここに定着します...^^* 今日も嬉しくてただ家の前に出るだけなのに掛けて出てきました!2つ買って本当に良かった~~~~😆
（余談ps. 景品抽選で当たったカードウォレットもなんでこんなに高級感があるんですか....?🥹財布も発売してください... ちなみにカードウォレットにお札を無理やり詰め込んだ...^^*）
text.EN:
Really... I couldn't be more satisfied. I'm a very poor person... I always buy bags and buy them again because I don't like them... But now I've really found a staple item.
It's mine from the time I first funded it! That's what I thought, but I didn't know I would like it this much. First of all, the color!!! texture!!! It’s so ridiculously luxurious and I love it!!! It's just the color I wanted. What really surprised me was the lining! The color is so pretty, luxurious... and very solid. Both inside and outside!! If you're a shaky person like me, you'll get something on your bag, drop it, and get scratched, so there's no need to worry! The stitching is also very solid.
And the highlight of this bag... storage capacity!!! I always carry around 3 pouches. They said they would separate them by type... Then I always felt like my bag would explode, but I left all the pouches at home. No, it's like this? I keep going in so much that I want to go in haha. It's even spacious haha. I'm so excited. Really.
I'll just settle my bag here...^^* I was so excited today that I carried it even though I was just leaving in front of the house! I was so glad I bought two~~~~😆
(TMI ps. Why are the card wallets I received from the prize draw so luxurious...?🥹 Please release wallets too... Meanwhile, I stuffed bills into the card wallet...^^*)

text.KO:
가방 이쁩니다😍 우연히 발견하고 마침 가방도 필요해서 쪼~금 고민하다 펀딩했는데 크기도 딱 적당하고 디자인 심플하고 좋아요.
매번 무광만 들다 유광은 처음인데 빤딱빤딱 볼때마다 설레네요. 제일 먼저 바느질부터 꼼꼼히 살폈는데 한땀한땀 잘 되어있어요.
원래 파우치 없이 립, 팩트 굴러다니는거 주섬주섬 찾아꺼내 썼는데 주머니에 쏙쏙 들어가 있으니 더듬더듬 찾을 필요 없는 편리함!
다른 색상도 탐나요~ 펀딩한 나 칭찬해🤗
개인적으로 아쉬운 점이 있다면 밴딩파우치포켓에 사용된 똑딱이버튼이 좀 불편해요. 여기도 자석이었으면 더 좋았을 것 같은 느낌.. 그래서 잠그지 않고 덮어놓기만 했어요ㅋㅋ
그리고 제 가방만 그런건지 편하게 손잡이를 들(었다 놓으)면 가방 정면에서 봤을 때 오른쪽이 올라가서 좀 삐뚤어지네요. 자주들어서 길이 들면 괜찮아지는건지..모양을 잡아주면 되지만, 조금 신경쓰이긴하네요😭 근데 진짜 다른 색상도 고민될만큼 예뻐요!!!!
text.JA:
バッグ可愛いです😍 偶然見つけて、ちょうどバッグも必要だったので少し悩んでファンディングしたんですが、サイズもちょうどよくてデザインもシンプルでいいです。
毎回マットなものばかり持っていたので艶ありは初めてなんですが、ピカピカ見るたびにワクワクします。まず縫製から丁寧にチェックしたんですが、一針一針しっかりできています。
もともとポーチなしでリップやコンパクトが転がっているのをごそごそ探して使っていたんですが、ポケットにすっぽり入っているので手探りで探す必要がない便利さ!
他のカラーも欲しいです〜ファンディングした自分を褒めたい🤗
個人的に残念な点があるとすれば、バンド式ポーチポケットに使われているスナップボタンが少し不便です。ここも磁石だったらもっと良かった感じ..それで留めずにただ被せておくだけにしました笑
それと私のバッグだけなのか、気軽に持ち手を持ったり離したりすると正面から見た時右側が上がって少し斜めになります。よく持ち歩いて馴染めば大丈夫になるのか..形を整えれば大丈夫ですが、少し気になりますね😭でも本当に他のカラーも気になるくらい綺麗です!!!!
text.EN:
The bag is pretty 😍 I found it by chance and needed a bag at the same time, so I thought about it for a while before purchasing it. The size is just right and the design is simple and nice.
I always get matte, but this is my first time with gloss, and I get excited every time I see it. First, I looked closely at the sewing, and every single stitch was done well.
Originally, I had to look for the lip and compact rolls around to use them without a pouch, but since they fit comfortably in my pocket, it's convenient so I don't have to fumble around looking for them!
I want other colors too~ Praise me for funding🤗
Personally, if I have one regret, the snap button used on the banding pouch pocket is a bit uncomfortable. I feel like it would have been better if there were magnets here too... So I just covered it without locking it haha.
And maybe it's just my bag, but when I lift (and release) the handle comfortably, the right side of the bag rises and looks a bit crooked when viewed from the front. I don't know if it will be okay as I wear it often and it gets longer...I just need to shape it, but I'm a little worried😭 But it's so pretty that I'm worried about other colors!!!!

ブルーミングバッグを知ったのは、夏休みに持って行けるバッグを探していたらインスタのアルゴリズムを通して知ることになりました!
ファンディングだったので休みの間に受け取れなくて諦めようとしたんですが、ずっと頭から離れなくて休みを諦めてファンディングに参加しました😂

最近天気も良くて早く引っ越しを終わらせてブルーミングバッグを持ってお出かけしないといけないですね😆☀️

次のファンディング再参加、絶対!!!絶対参加します!!🖤🖤
text.EN:
I learned about Blooming Bag through the Instagram algorithm while looking for a bag to take with me on summer vacation!
Since it was funding, I wasn't able to get it during my vacation so I was about to give up, but the twinkle in my eye kept giving up so I gave up on my vacation and participated in the funding😂
After that, I suddenly moved, so I was worried about what would happen if I arrived later, but fortunately, it arrived the day before I moved!!🫶❤️
I opened it while I was busy packing,,,, and was surprised at how pretty it was!!!!!!!🥰
The satisfaction is as good as the long wait,,,,!!!!!!!!!!! :D I think it will be included in the best items purchased in 2023!👏👏👏
The weather is nice these days, so I guess I'll finish moving and go out with my blooming bag😆☀️
I bought it with my own money, but thank you for making such a pretty bag😎🫶
Definitely re-participating in the next funding!!! I will definitely participate!!🖤🖤

text.JA:
宅配便の発送通知を受け取って、こんなにワクワクしたのは初めてかもしれません。宅配ボックスにカラー名が刻印されているのも初めてです〜！アイデアが素敵ですね笑 まずは第一の感動……でも、これはまだ始まりにすぎません！
待ちに待ったブルーミングバッグの箱を開けた瞬間、思わず「わぁ！」と声が出ました。カラーが本当にすごいです😭 バターイエロー……黄色っぽく見えるのに、どこか黄緑っぽさもあって……この色味、どう説明したらいいんでしょう？ 本当にバターみたいに、私の心までとろ〜っと溶かしてしまうような色です😭
バッグを開けて、いろいろ入れてみました。クッションファンデーション2個、リップスティック3本、カードケース、ルイ・ヴィトンの長財布、モバイルバッテリー、日焼け止め、Bluetoothイヤホン……とにかくどんどん入れてみたのに、上の部分にはまだこんなに余裕があります。
収納力、本当にすごい！！！ そしてもう一つ嬉しかったのが、隠しポケット！ 生理用品のように、バッグを開けたときに見られたくないものを入れるのにぴったりです。それだけでも感動なのに、ポケットのフラップにもスナップボタンが付いているのを見て、また感動！ 普通はフラップがなかったり、ファスナーやマジックテープが付いていたりすることが多いのに、スナップボタンまで付いているなんて、この細やかなセンスが素敵です！
そして私はリップスティックが大好きで、たくさん持ち歩くタイプなのですが、リップスティック用のポケットが2つではなく3つもあるので、本当に嬉しいです。カードポケットもありますよ笑
バッグの底には底鋲も付いているので、バッグもしっかり保護できます。
バッグの背面にもポケットがあります。これがあるので、背面を表にして持つとまた違った雰囲気になります〜。
そして、バッグのストラップはバッグの内側にある穴に通せるようになっているので、ストラップを外さなくてもバッグの内側に隠すことができます。ストラップを外して使うことも、内側に通して使うこともできて、その日の気分に合わせて好きなように持てます。
革の質感もとても綺麗に表現されていて、すごく高級感があります♡
バッグ上部のハンドルには、2本のストラップをまとめるリングも付いています。なので、2本のストラップを一つにまとめて使うこともできますし、そのまま2本で使うこともできます笑
私は一つにまとめたほうがすっきりして見えるので、リングでまとめて使っています〜。
このバッグの欠点は何でしょう？？ そして、そして……ずっと出てきますね。レビューに写真を5枚までしか載せられないことが唯一の欠点です笑
（あ……本当に自慢したいところが多すぎるんです）
バッグが届いた翌日、さっそく持って出かけました。
会社へ向かう足取りが、なんだかいつもより軽いんです笑
地下鉄でも、みんなが私のバッグを見ているような気がします笑
ワンピースに合わせてもすごく可愛いし、Tシャツに肩掛けしてもとてもよく似合います。ストラップを通す穴で長さを調節してクロスボディにしたら、カジュアルで可愛くなりそうですよね？
私、なんでこれ一つしか買わなかったんだろう？ 自分の指が恨めしいです😭
四季を通して季節を問わず使える、本当にお得感のあるバッグだと思います。
色味も綺麗で、実用的で、収納力も抜群で、デザインも素敵なバッグを作ってくださって本当にありがとうございます♡ これからもずっとyyeonを応援していくので、これからも可愛くて素敵なバッグをたくさん作ってください。
（2023-10-06 20:58 ワディズのファンディングに登録された購入レビュー）
text.EN:
I think this is the first time I’ve ever gotten so excited just from receiving a delivery notification. It’s also the first time I’ve seen the color name engraved on a delivery box~ What a great idea haha. First impression… and this is only the beginning!
As soon as I opened the Blooming Bag box I had been waiting and waiting for, I couldn’t help but let out a gasp. The color is absolutely incredible😭 Butter Yellow… It looks yellow, but there’s also a hint of green to it… How am I supposed to describe this color? It feels like my heart is melting softly, just like real butter😭
I opened the bag and started putting all sorts of things inside: two compacts, three lipsticks, a card wallet, a Louis Vuitton medium-sized wallet, a portable battery, sunscreen, and Bluetooth earbuds… I just kept tossing things in, yet there was still this much room left at the top.
The storage capacity is seriously impressive!!! And another thing I loved was the hidden pocket!! It’s perfect for putting things like sanitary pads that you don’t want visible when you open your bag. I was also impressed to see that the pocket cover has a snap button too!! Usually there’s either no cover, or there’s a zipper or Velcro, but this one even has a snap closure—such a thoughtful detail!!
And I’m a total lipstick hoarder, so I love that there are three lipstick slots instead of just two. There’s also a card pocket haha.
There are protective metal studs on the bottom of the bag too, so they help protect the bag.
There’s also a pocket on the back of the bag… so even carrying it with the back facing outward gives it a different look~
And the strap is designed so that it can be threaded through the holes on the inside of the bag, which means you can hide the strap inside without removing it. You can wear it however you like—either with the strap taken out or tucked inside.
The leather texture is also beautifully finished, making it look incredibly luxurious♡
There’s also a loop on the top handle that keeps the two handles together, so you can combine them into one like this, or use the two handles separately.
I prefer the cleaner look of keeping them together, so I fastened them with the loop~
What could possibly be the downside of this bag?? I keep saying “and then, and then…” haha. I guess the only downside is that you can upload a maximum of five photos with your reviewㅋㅋ.
(Ah… I seriously have way too much to brag about.)
I took the bag out with me the very next day after it arrived.
Why do my steps feel so much lighter on the way to work? Haha
I feel like everyone on the subway is looking at my bag haha.
It looks absolutely adorable with a dress, and it also goes really well when worn over the shoulder with a T-shirt. If you adjust the length using the strap holes and wear it crossbody, don’t you think it would look super cute and casual?
Why did I only buy one? I’m honestly mad at myself for not buying more😭
I think it’s such a versatile bag that you can carry all year round, regardless of the season.
Thank you so much for making such a beautiful and practical bag with gorgeous colors, amazing storage capacity, and a wonderful design♡ I’ll continue to support yyeon, so please keep making lots of beautiful and wonderful bags.

text.JA:
ついに待ちに待ったブルーミングバッグが届きました〜！
ファンディングしてから届くのをずっと待っていたのですが、連休が早く終わってほしいと思ったのは今回が初めてです笑
仕事中に配送完了の通知を受け取った瞬間から、もうワクワクしていました！
宅配便の箱が思ったより小さかったので、バッグが折れたり型崩れしたりしていないか心配だったのですが、バッグの形そのままに綺麗に入っていました〜。
バッグの形が崩れないように丁寧に梱包されているのが伝わってきて、箱を開けた瞬間から嬉しい気持ちになりました😊
私はいつも、雨が降っても雪が降っても晴れていても、バッグの中に傘を入れておかないと安心できないタイプなのですが、18cmの傘も余裕を持ってすっぽり入りました！
そして傘の横に財布を入れて、Budsとリップスティック、上にはハンドクリーム、さらに横の収納スペースにはくしと鏡、頭痛薬、USB、リップバーム、目薬、香水まで入れてみたのですが、それでもまだまだ余裕がありました〜。
傘を入れたことで横の収納スペースが押されていたのに、それでも無理なく全部入れることができました！
出勤するときに必要なものを全部入れても、余裕で収納できます！
そして、あの隠しポケットは生理用品を入れるのにぴったりです……。
サイズが本当にちょうどいいです〜！
バッグの外側を見ると、縫製もとても綺麗で、デザインも本当に可愛いです〜。
バッグの前面と背面でデザインが違うので、その日の気分に合わせて向きを変えて使えそうです😍😍😍
カラーも画面で見た通りの、上品で高級感のある色味です〜。
そして一番気に入ったのが、バッグのハンドル部分に固定するパーツが付いているところです！
これまでハンドル付きのバッグをたくさん使ってきましたが、固定するものがないとハンドルがずり落ちて、ストラップが切れてしまったこともありました😭
でもブルーミングバッグには固定するパーツが付いているので、ハンドルがずり落ちる心配もなく、バッグ本来の形を綺麗に保てそうです😊
ストラップも付けてみましたが、長さも自由に調節できますし、しっかりしていて丈夫そうです！
ストラップの取り付けも難しくなく、すぐに付けることができました😊
そして何より、本当に軽いです〜！
いつも傘をバッグに入れて持ち歩くので、バッグ自体は軽いものがいいと思っていたのですが、バッグが軽いので長時間持っていても肩が痛くならなくて、本当に嬉しいです😍😍😍
そして、バッグの生地が床に直接触れないようにする細やかな工夫まで！ 本当に細部まで丁寧にデザインされているのが、じっくり見なくても伝わってきます♥️♥️♥️
丁寧に検品してくださったおかげで、とても綺麗なバッグが届いたんだなと思います〜。
他のバッグもファンディングされたら、購入する気満々です！

text.EN:
Finally, the Blooming Bag I had been waiting and waiting for has arrived~
I had been waiting for my order to arrive after backing the project, but this is the first time I’ve actually found myself wishing a holiday would end sooner hahaha.
I was at work when I got the delivery confirmation, and I was instantly so excited!
The delivery box was smaller than I expected, so I was worried that the bag might be crushed or wrinkled, but it was packed beautifully in its original shape~
As soon as I opened the box, I felt so happy because I could tell that the bag had been carefully packed to keep its shape😊
I’m the type who feels uneasy if I don’t carry an umbrella in my bag, whether it’s raining, snowing, or sunny, and even an 18 cm umbrella fit inside with plenty of room!
I also put my wallet next to the umbrella, my Buds and lipstick, hand cream on top, and a comb, mirror, headache medicine, USB drive, lip balm, artificial tears, and perfume in the side compartment—and there was still so much room left~
Even though the umbrella was pressing against the side compartment, I was still able to fit everything in without any trouble!
I managed to fit everything I need for work with room to spare!
And that hidden pocket is absolutely perfect for sanitary pads...
The size is just right~
The stitching on the outside of the bag is so neat, and the design is really beautiful too~
The front and back of the bag have different designs, so I think it’ll be fun to switch up which side I carry depending on the day😍😍😍
The color is just as elegant and luxurious as it looked on screen~
Another thing I really love is the little piece that keeps the bag handles together~
I’ve used a lot of bags with handles before, but without something to hold the handles in place, they would slip down and eventually the straps would break😭
But the Blooming Bag has a piece that keeps the handles secured, so I won’t have to worry about them slipping down, and the bag should stay nicely in its original shape😊
I also attached the shoulder strap, and the length can be adjusted however I like. It feels very sturdy too!
It wasn’t difficult to attach the strap either, so I was able to put it on in no time😊
And above all, it’s really lightweight~
I always carry an umbrella in my bag, so I really wanted a lightweight bag. I love that my shoulders don’t hurt even after carrying it for a long time because the bag itself is so light😍😍😍
And I even love the thoughtful detail that keeps the fabric of the bag from touching the floor! You can tell how carefully it was designed even without looking closely♥️♥️♥️
I feel like I received such a beautiful bag thanks to the careful quality inspection~
I would 100% buy another bag if you launch another one through funding!
This is the most satisfying funding project I’ve ever backed on Wadiz❤️
It’s so beautiful that I regret only buying one🤣 I really should have bought more...
I received it right after the Chuseok holiday ended and before another holiday began, so it felt like I had been given a gift~
Thank you so much for this beautiful bag! I’ll take good care of it and use it well!

text.KO:

그간 와디즈에서 산 것들이 만족도가 높았어서 기대감이 컸었나 봅니다...🤣

가방 자체는 디자인도 컬러도 참 예쁘고 사이즈도 딱 원하던 거라, 화요일 출근에 당장 들고 나갈 거지만!
주문 후 다른 가방 구매 안 하고 기다린만큼... 내적 친밀감도 생겼고 아쉬움도 남아서 리뷰 남깁니다!
text.JA:
ノートパソコンが入る大きいバッグばかり持ち歩いていました
ノートパソコンがない時に広いバッグの中で細々したアイテムが転がるのが面倒でバッグを購入することになりました!
ブルーミングバッグを待つ間、紙袋やキャンバスバッグを持ち歩きながらなんとか耐えていたんですが!バッグを受け取ってみると..
思ったより作りが😂😂...ポーチフリーバッグというので化粧品を入れるのに特化した細やかなデザインかと思っていたんですが..普通のハンドバッグに付いているのと変わらないです
そして外側の蓋と一番内側の収納ポケットがスナップボタンで留めるようになっているんですが、うまくくっつかず取れにくいです...きちんと合わせないとくっつかず取れないので、スナップを見ようとしてバッグがひっくり返ってガシャッと..(涙)
これまでWadizで買ったものが満足度が高かったので期待値が大きかったみたいです...🤣
📌まとめると...
1. ポーチフリーと宣伝された分、化粧品を入れやすいよう差別化された点があれば良かったと思います!（こういうことならバッグが小さくてどうせポーチは入らないという意味に読めそうです..）
2. スナップボタンで可愛いですがもう少しくっつけたり外したりしやすいといいです!
+追加）個人的な好みかもしれませんが...ブラウンバッグの裏地が水色なのが少し合わない気がします......🫠
バッグ自体はデザインも色もすごく綺麗でサイズもちょうど求めていたものなので、火曜の出勤にすぐ持って行きますが!
注文後他のバッグを買わずに待った分...内的な親近感も湧きましたし残念な気持ちも残ってレビューを残します!
text.EN:
I only carried a large bag that could fit my laptop.
I bought a bag because it was annoying to have small items rolling around in my spacious bag when I didn't have my laptop with me!
While waiting for the Blooming Bag, I've been carrying around a paper bag and a canvas bag and I've been holding up well! When I received the bag...
The build quality was better than I expected😂😂... I thought it would be a meticulous design specialized for storing cosmetics since it's a pouch bag... but it's no different from just a regular handbag.
And the outer lid and the innermost storage pocket are filled with snaps, but they don't stick well and don't fall off... You have to align them exactly so they stick and fall off, and when you try to look at the snaps, the bag flips over..ㅜ
I guess I had high expectations because I was very satisfied with the things I bought from Wadiz so far...🤣
📌To summarize...
1. As it was advertised as pouch-free, it would have been nice if there had been some differentiation to make it easier to put cosmetics in! (This would likely be read as meaning that the bag is too small to fit a pouch anyway.)
2. It's pretty because it snaps on, but I wish it were a little easier to attach and remove!
+Additional) It may be personal preference, but... I think the light blue lining of the brown bag is a little less pretty...🫠
The bag itself has a really pretty design and color, and the size is exactly what I wanted, so I'm going to take it with me to work on Tuesday!
As much as I waited without purchasing another bag after ordering... I developed an inner sense of intimacy, but I also felt some regret, so I'm leaving a review!

보부상이지만 미니백은 또 기가 막히게 좋아하는 사람… 근데 미니백 안에는 제가 원하는 걸 다 못 넣어서 많은 걸 포기해야했던 사람… 그 사람이 바로 저고요, 그래서 인스타 알고리즘으로 만난 블루밍백은 정말 덕통사고 그잡채 ㅠ 와디즈 가입은 해 놨었는데 그 때도 뭔가를 사려고 가입했다가 프로젝트 오픈하고는 마음이 바뀌어서 구매를 안 했던 거 같아요. 그치만 블루밍백은 오픈 전 부터 눈에 불을 켜고 기다리고 뜨자마자 접속은 했는데 거기서 약간의 망설임이 있었지만 다행히 슈퍼 얼리버드로 결제! 하늘색 넘 좋아해서 베이비블루로 픽했는데 역시나 탁월한 결정이었던 거 같아요 ㅠ 하늘색으로 넘 도배하는 건 아닌가 싶어서 버터 옐로우로도 약간 마음이 기울었는데 하늘색에 같이 매치를 해도 역시 하늘 아래 같은 하늘색 없구나 했다는 ㅎㅎ 넘 예쁘죠!!! ㅠㅠ 인마이백은 사실 여기 리뷰로는 제 마음 다 못 담을 거 같아서 블로그에 후기를 남겼어요!! 펀딩은 다 끝났지만 쨔쟌 내가 이렇게 예쁜걸 샀다~ 하는 마음으로용 ㅎㅅㅎ 못 사신 분들 죄송… (?) 네번째 사진 속 저 많고 굵직한 친구들이 다 가방으로 들어가는걸 저도 영상으로 찍어봤어요 히히 어떻게 보부상이 미니백 가지고 다닐 수 있나 싶었는데 이게 말이 되는구나!! ㅠㅠ 너무 예뻐서 실외 나가서 찍어봤는데 찍길 잘했다 싶어용 ㅎㅎ 넘 존예링… 예쁘고 실용성 좋은 가방 만들어 주셔서 감사해요!
아 근데 너무 좋은 말만 써 놨는데 일단 제대로 뭐가 좋냐면
1. 색상이 너무 잘 뽑혔다… 그저 예술
2. 생각보다 더 가벼웠던 가방 무게! 가죽도 탄탄한데 부드럽고 은은한 광택이 예뻐요! 분명 광택이 있는데 무광 너낌
3. 두꺼워서 잘 못 들고 다니던 쿠션과 핸드크림도 허용 가능한 넉넉한 내부!
4. 저만큼 다 넣어도 크게 무겁다는 느낌이 안 드는 신기한 가방!! (원체 제가 무거운 가방을 들고 다녀서 그런건진 모르겠습니다만…)
5. 가방을 내려놨을 때 안정감있게 떨어지고 오염이 방지되는 바닥!! 아주 굿…
6. 빵빵하게 다 들어가있는데 털털 털어도 열리지 않는 자석!

text.JA:
荷物は多いけど、ミニバッグがめちゃくちゃ大好きな人……。でも、ミニバッグには自分が入れたいものを全部入れられなくて、いろいろ諦めてきた人……。それがまさに私です。そして、そんな私がInstagramのアルゴリズムで出会ったブルーミングバッグは、まさに一目惚れならぬ「運命の出会い」でした😭
ワディズには以前から登録していたのですが、そのときも何か買おうと思って登録したものの、プロジェクトがオープンする頃には気が変わって、結局購入しなかった気がします。
でもブルーミングバッグは、オープン前から目を光らせてずっと待っていて、公開された瞬間にすぐアクセスしました！ そこで少しだけ迷ったものの、幸いスーパーアーリーバードで購入できました！
スカイブルーが大好きなのでベビーブルーを選んだのですが、やっぱり最高の選択だったと思います😭 ちょっとスカイブルーに寄せすぎかなと思って、バターイエローにも少し心が揺れたのですが、スカイブルーのアイテムと合わせてみても、やっぱり「空の下に同じ空色はないんだな」と思うくらい、本当に綺麗でした笑 すごく可愛いですよね！！！😭🩵
「インマイバッグ」は、正直ここでのレビューだけでは私の気持ちを全部伝えきれないと思って、ブログにもレビューを残しました！！ ファンディングはもう終わっていますが、「じゃじゃーん、私こんなに可愛いもの買ったんだ〜！」という気持ちで笑 まだ購入できていない方には申し訳ない……？
4枚目の写真に写っている、あの大きくて存在感のある荷物たちが全部バッグに入るところを、私も動画に撮ってみました。こんなに荷物が多い私がミニバッグを持ち歩けるのかなと思っていたのですが、「あ、これなら本当にいけるんだ！」と思いました😭😭
あまりにも可愛かったので外に出て写真も撮ってみたのですが、撮ってよかった〜と思っています笑 本当にめちゃくちゃ可愛いです……。
こんなに可愛くて実用性も高いバッグを作ってくださってありがとうございます！

あ、でも良いことばかり書いているので、改めて何がそんなに良かったのかというと……
1. カラーが本当に綺麗に仕上がっている……ただただ芸術です。
2. 思っていたよりさらに軽かったバッグの重さ！ 革もしっかりしているのに柔らかくて、ほんのりとした光沢が綺麗です！ ちゃんと艶があるのに、どこかマットな感じもあって素敵です。
3. 厚みがあって今まで持ち歩くのを諦めていたクッションファンデーションやハンドクリームまで入れられる、余裕のある内側の収納スペース！
4. 私がこれだけたくさん入れても、そこまで重く感じない不思議なバッグ！！ （もともと重いバッグを持ち歩いているからなのかもしれませんが……）
5. バッグを置いたときに安定感があり、汚れも防いでくれる底！ とても良いです……。
6. 中身をパンパンに入れていても、軽く振ってみても開かないマグネット！

惜しいところは……えーっと……特にないですね……？ ただ、一つしか買わなかった自分が惜しいだけ……？ まあ、そういうことです^^笑
あ、でも一つありました！ 内側のスナップボタンが少し開け閉めしにくいところかな？ でもまあ……可愛いから全然OKです〜。

あまりにも可愛いバッグなので、写真も動画もたくさん撮ってしまったのですが、ここには5枚までしか載せられないのがちょっと残念ですㅠㅠ
[https://m.blog.naver.com/hyemtoring/223230827470
ブログにもレビューを載せているのですが、ここに載せても大丈夫かな……？？]
とにかく、ブルーミングバッグの可愛さをたっぷり詰め込んでみました🥹🩵 ベビーブルー最高！！！

text.EN:
I’m someone who carries a lot of stuff but absolutely loves mini bags… But because I can never fit everything I want into a mini bag, I’ve always had to give up carrying a lot of things… and that person is me. So when I discovered the Blooming Bag through the Instagram algorithm, it was truly love at first sight😭
I had already signed up for Wadiz, but I think I originally joined because I wanted to buy something, then changed my mind after the project opened and ended up not purchasing anything. But with the Blooming Bag, I was eagerly waiting for it even before launch and logged in the moment it went live. I hesitated a little at that point, but luckily I managed to purchase it as a Super Early Bird!
I absolutely love sky blue, so I picked Baby Blue, and I think it was definitely the right choice😭 I briefly considered Butter Yellow because I wondered if I was going overboard with sky blue, but even when I styled it with other sky-blue items, I realized that there really is no sky blue quite like this one haha. It’s so pretty!!!😭🩵
As for my “In My Bag,” I honestly felt like I couldn’t fit all my feelings into a review here, so I also posted a review on my blog!! The funding campaign is already over, but I wanted to share it with the feeling of, “Ta-da! I bought something this pretty~” haha. Sorry to those who missed out on buying it… (?)
I also filmed a video showing how all those big, bulky items in the fourth photo actually fit inside the bag. I was wondering how someone like me, who carries so much stuff, could possibly use a mini bag, but now I know it really is possible!!😭😭
It was so pretty that I went outside to take some photos too, and I’m really glad I did haha. It’s seriously gorgeous… Thank you for making such a beautiful and practical bag!

Ah, but I’ve only been saying good things, so let me properly explain what I love about it:
1. The color is unbelievably beautiful… It’s simply a work of art.
2. The bag is even lighter than I expected! The leather is sturdy but soft, with a beautiful subtle sheen. It definitely has a shine to it, but somehow still has a matte feel.
3. The interior is spacious enough for things like a cushion compact and hand cream that I usually avoided carrying because they’re relatively thick!
4. It’s such an amazing bag that even with everything I put inside, it doesn’t feel particularly heavy!! (Although maybe that’s because I’m used to carrying heavy bags…)
5. The bottom sits securely when you put the bag down and helps protect it from dirt and stains!! So good…
6. The magnet stays securely closed even when the bag is packed full and you give it a good shake!

As for anything disappointing… hmm… honestly, not really…? I’m just disappointed that I only bought one…? Yep, that’s about it^^ haha. Oh, there is one thing! The snap button on the inside is a little difficult to open and close. But honestly… it’s so pretty that I don’t even mind~

It’s such a beautiful bag that I ended up taking tons of photos and videos, but it’s a little disappointing that I can only upload five photos hereㅠㅠ
https://m.blog.naver.com/hyemtoring/223230827470
I posted a review on my blog too. Is it okay if I share it here…?? Anyway, I tried to capture just how pretty the Blooming Bag is🥹🩵 Baby Blue is the best!!!

text.JA:
きゃー！ついに週末に可愛いバッグを持ってデートしてきたので、レビューを書きます！写真を撮るのがあまり上手じゃないので、これが精一杯ですㅠㅠ
♥️デザイン
まず、とにかく可愛いですㅜㅜ 本当に可愛い……。思っていたより実物のほうがずっと可愛くて、実物を見た瞬間に「これは色違いで集めなきゃ……」と思いましたㅠㅠㅠㅠ
高級感のあるクラック加工？のような質感と、なめらかな手触り……。柔らかく綺麗に仕上げられたデザインで、表裏どちらも使えるのも素敵です。
本当に高価なバッグにも負けないくらい高級感があります。
内側の水色のポイントも可愛いです！
私は個人的に、クロスストラップを付けずに持つほうが可愛いと思いました笑
💛バターイエロー
文字通りバターのような色です！ とっても可愛い菜の花色？レモン色？に白を混ぜたような、派手すぎないけれどありきたりでもない、まさにそんな色……。華やかさそのものです。春にしか持てないかなと思っていたのですが、実際に届いてみると、コーディネート次第で一年中愛用できそうです笑
写真で色味を表現するのが難しかったのですが、実物に一番近く撮れた気がします！
ベビーブルーとどちらにするか本当にすごく悩みましたが、どちらを選んでも後悔しなかったと思います！ いつかベビーブルーも私のものにしたいですㅜㅜ
🖤ブラック
もう何も言うことありません。シンプル・イズ・ザ・ベスト。どんなコーデにも合わせられて、本当に365日いつでも持てるブラックは、絶対に一つは持っておきたいカラーだと思います。と！に！か！く！可！愛！い！
カジュアルなコーデにも、きちんとしたコーデにもぴったり合ってしまう魔法のバッグです〜！
🩷使ってみて感じたこと
> ポーチいらずのバッグというだけあって、本当に便利です。ポーチを別に使わない私は、いつもバッグに手を入れてリップバームを一つ探すだけでも大変だったのですが、クッションファンデやティント、リップバームなどがそれぞれ決まった場所にきちんと収まるので、こんなに便利で快適なのかと驚きました。生活の質が上がりました！
> かなりたくさん入ります。同じくらいのサイズの他のバッグを使ったときより、たくさん入る感じがしました。バッグの中が整理されるからでしょうか。写真ではティントやクッションの定位置が分かるようにあえて少なめに入れていますが、ここにプラスして小さなデジタルカメラ、AirPods、モバイルバッテリー、小さなウェットティッシュまで全部入りました！
> 生理用ナプキンやライナーを入れるとポケットが膨らんでファスナーが閉まらなかったり、ポケットが伸びたり、バッグを開けるたびに中が丸見えになったりして、ちょっと気まずかったのですが、このアイデア……すごすぎます……。伸縮できるようにゴム仕様になっていて、その上からさらにカバーをかぶせて隠せるようになっているので、生理用ナプキンを大きめサイズで何枚か入れても問題なさそうです！ グッドです〜〜〜
前面のファスナーポケットにはカードや現金を入れて使っています笑
収納スペースごとにちゃんと役割が決まっているバッグだなんて……完璧すぎませんか？ 責任取ってください……私の通帳の責任も取って……！
第一印象があまりにも良かったので、他のバッグも購入したくなりました笑 可愛くて実用的なバッグを作ってくださってありがとうございます！ たくさん愛用します🫶🏻

text.EN:
Wow, I finally got to take this beautiful bag on a date over the weekend, so I’m writing a review! I’m not very good at taking photos, so this is the best I could doㅠㅠ
♥️Design
First of all, it’s beautifulㅜㅜ Really, really beautiful... It’s even prettier in person than I imagined. The moment I saw it in person, I thought, “I need to collect this in every color...”ㅠㅠㅠㅠ
It has such a luxurious, slightly crackled texture and a smooth feel... The design is beautifully shaped and can be used on both sides, which I love.
It has such a luxurious look that it can easily hold its own against even a really expensive bag.
The light blue accent on the inside is cute too!
Personally, I thought it looked prettier without the crossbody strap haha.
💛Butter Yellow
It’s literally the color of butter! Is it a beautiful forsythia yellow? A lemon yellow? It’s like a touch of white has been mixed in, so it’s bright without being too flashy, but it’s not boring or ordinary either... It’s pure brightness. I thought it might be a color I could only wear in spring, but now that I’ve actually received it, I think I can easily wear it all year round with the right styling haha.
It was hard to capture the color accurately in photos, but I think this turned out the closest to the actual color!
I had such a hard time choosing between this and Baby Blue, but honestly, I don’t think I would have regretted either choice! Someday, I definitely want to add Baby Blue to my collection tooㅜㅜ
🖤Black
What more can I say? Simple is best. I think a black bag like this is definitely a must-have because you can carry it with practically any outfit, 365 days a year. SO! PRETTY!
It’s a magical bag that looks perfect with both casual and dressed-up outfits~!
🩷What I noticed after using it
> As you’d expect from a pouch-free bag, it’s incredibly convenient. I don’t usually use a separate pouch, so I used to struggle every time I had to dig through my bag just to find a single lip balm. But now that my cushion compact, tint, lip balm, and other items each have their own designated place, I can’t believe how convenient it is. It really feels like a whole new world! My quality of life has definitely improved!
> It holds quite a lot. It actually feels like I can fit more than I could in other bags of a similar size. Maybe it’s because everything inside can be organized so well. In my photos, I didn’t put in too many things because I wanted to clearly show the designated spots for the tint and cushion, but on top of those, I was also able to fit a small digital camera, AirPods, a portable battery, and even a small pack of wet wipes!
> Whenever I put sanitary pads or panty liners in a bag, the pocket would bulge, the zipper wouldn’t close properly, the material would stretch, and I’d feel embarrassed because everything inside was visible whenever I opened the bag. But the thought put into this is just... amazing... The pocket is made with elastic so it can expand, and there’s another cover that folds over it to keep everything hidden. So I don’t think there would be any problem even if I put several large sanitary pads inside! So good~~~
I keep my cards and cash in the front zippered pocket haha.
A bag where every compartment has its own perfectly defined purpose... Isn’t that just too perfect? Take responsibility... Take responsibility for my bank account...!
I loved the bag so much from the first impression that now I want to buy the other bags too haha. Thank you for making such a beautiful and practical bag! I’ll be using it all the time🫶🏻

text.KO:
가방을 받고 기대보다 예뻐서 놀랐어요. 수납력는 어찌나 좋은지~ 제가 별명이 도라에몽일 정도로 평소 보부상처럼 가방에 이것저것 넣고 다니는데 그게 다 들어가더라구요. 가방 안에서 다 섞여서 뭐하나 찾으려면 시간 걸리고… 가방 뒤집고… ㅠ 너무 깔끔하게 잘 들어가 있으니 이제 이런 일도 없어서 좋았어요. 가방 개시한 날 지인이 보자마자 가방 예쁘다고 본인도 사고 싶다고 해서 공유하고 재펀딩 요청하라고 했어요. 저도 재펀딩 요청 꾹~~~ 꼭 재펀딩해주셨으면 좋겠어요. 파스텔톤으로 하나 더 사고 싶네요.
청바지에도 정장에도 다 잘어울려서 활용도도 좋아요. 이런 요물이 왜 이제야 나왔는지^^ 한동안 매력에서 못 빠져나올 것 같네요.
text.JA:
バッグを受け取って期待以上に綺麗で驚きました。収納力もどれだけ良いか~ 私はあだ名がドラえもんと呼ばれるくらい普段荷物が多くてバッグにあれこれ入れて持ち歩くんですが、それが全部入りました。バッグの中でごちゃ混ぜになって何か探すのに時間がかかって…バッグをひっくり返して…(涙)でもすごくすっきり収納できるのでもうそういうこともなくて良かったです。バッグを使い始めた日、知人が見てすぐ綺麗だと言って自分も欲しいと言うので共有して再ファンディング要請しろと言いました。私も再ファンディング要請押しまくり~~~ぜひ再ファンディングしてほしいです。パステルトーンでもう一つ買いたいです。
ジーンズにもスーツにもよく合って使い勝手もいいです。こんないい商品がなんで今まで出なかったのか^^しばらく魅力から抜け出せなさそうです。
text.EN:
When I received the bag, I was surprised that it was prettier than I expected. The storage capacity is so good~ My nickname is Doraemon, so I usually carry various things in my bag like someone who carries a lot of things, and everything fits in it. Everything is mixed up in the bag, so it takes time to find something... Turn the bag over... ㅠ It was so neat and tidy that I didn't have to worry about anything like this anymore. The day the bag was launched, a friend of mine saw the bag and said he thought it was pretty and wanted to buy it, so I told him to share it and request another funding campaign. I also request another funding campaign. I really hope you relaunch it. I want to buy another one in pastel colors.
It goes well with both jeans and a suit, so it is very versatile. I wonder why this kind of monster has only come out now ^^ I don’t think I will be able to escape its charm for a while.

text.KO:
배송을 기다리고기다리고기다렸는데 드디어 제 손에 들어왔네요!!
벅스를 열었을때 더스트백에 담겨있는 가방을 보는데 감동이..
편지도 감사합니다!!!
색상 고민을 진짜 많이 했는데 버터옐로우색이 기대했던 것 보다 더 이뻐요.
버터옐로우가 포인트도 되면서 어느 색, 어떤 스타일에도 잘 어울립니다.
스트랩 연결해서 숄더로 매도 이쁘지만 역시 토드백으로 손에 들고 있는게 가장 이쁘네요.
안감도 하늘색이라 옐로우랑 색 조합이 좋고 팩트, 립스틱 공간 등 공간이 많아 파우치를 별도로 안 들고 다녀도 되고
가방크기보다 많이 들어가서 보부상인 자도 가볍게 들고 다닐수 있어요.
디자인도 고급스럽고 가방 밑에 징이 있어 바닥면이 바닥에 직접적으로 닿지 않으니 화장실 이용할 때 물 있는 세면대에 잠시 가방을 올려놔도 걱정이 없습니다!!!
버터옐로우 색상과 가방을 보니 다른 색 가방도 사고싶어지네요...
만약 다음에 또 펀딩을 할 예정이라면 같은 라인으로 태블릿도 들어갈 사이즈의 큰 사이즈의 가방을 만들어보는 것도 어떨까싶네요.
요즘 날씨에도 잘 어울리고 제 최애 가방이 되었어요.
덕분에 이쁘게 잘 들고다닐께요!!
text.JA:
配送を待って待って待ってやっと私の手元に届きました!!
箱を開けた時ダストバッグに入ったバッグを見て感動が..
手紙もありがとうございます!!!
色をすごく悩んだんですが、バターイエローが期待していたよりさらに綺麗です。
バターイエローがポイントにもなりつつどんな色、どんなスタイルにもよく合います。
ストラップを付けてショルダーにしても綺麗ですが、やっぱりトートバッグとして手に持つのが一番綺麗ですね。
裏地も水色なのでイエローとの色の組み合わせが良くて、コンパクトや口紅の収納スペースなど多くてポーチを別に持ち歩かなくてもいいですし、
バッグのサイズよりたくさん入るので荷物が多い私でも軽く持ち歩けます。
デザインも高級感があってバッグの底に鋲があるので底面が直接地面に触れないので、トイレを使う時水がある洗面台に一時バッグを置いても心配ありません!!!
バターイエローの色とバッグを見ると他の色のバッグも欲しくなります...
もし次にまたファンディングする予定があれば同じラインでタブレットも入るサイズの大きいバッグを作ってみるのはどうかなと思います。
最近の天気にもよく合って私の一番のお気に入りのバッグになりました。
おかげさまで綺麗に大切に持ち歩きます!!
text.EN:
I waited and waited for delivery, but it finally arrived in my hands!!
When I opened Bugs and saw the bag in the dust bag, I was moved.
Thank you for your letter too!!!
I really thought about the color, but the butter yellow color is prettier than I expected.
The butter yellow is the highlight and goes well with any color and style.
It's pretty when you attach the strap and wear it over the shoulder, but it's prettiest when you hold it in your hand as a tote bag.
The lining is also light blue, so the color combination with yellow is good, and there is plenty of space for pacts, lipsticks, etc., so you don't have to carry a separate pouch.
It fits more than the size of the bag, so even someone who carries a lot of things can carry it comfortably.
The design is luxurious and there is a stud at the bottom of the bag so the bottom does not come into direct contact with the floor, so you don't have to worry about putting the bag on a sink with water for a moment when using the bathroom!!!
Seeing the butter yellow color and bag makes me want to buy bags in other colors...
If you plan to back another funding campaign again next time, I think it would be a good idea to make a large bag that can fit a tablet using the same line.
It goes well with the weather these days and has become my favorite bag.
Thanks to you, I will carry it around nicely!!
