text.JA:
ファンディング番号12748573

写真に一目惚れしてクリックして、
ストーリーを読んで通知登録＋予定のアラームを設定して、
オープン前に追加されていく写真を見ながら
悩みに悩んでファンディングすることにしたメロウバッグ！

子どもがいるので、いつも荷物が多いのですが、
今ではおむつバッグは卒業したものの、
まだ子どものものと自分のものを一緒に入れているので、
バッグの中のポーチは必須でした。
でもメロウバッグなら、いわゆる「荷物の多い人向けバッグ」から卒業できそうです^^

まず、良かったところを挙げてみると……

1. とにかく可愛い、本当にすごく可愛いです！

正直、これだけでファンディングしたようなものです……収納力はおまけです。
とにかく写真で見た通り、本当に可愛いんです。
ブラック＋ゴールドの金具！ これは定番の必須アイテムじゃないですか。
メッキが薄くて安っぽく見えるものも多いのに、
これは本当に完璧！！！ 深みのあるゴールドです💛

そして光沢も強すぎず、ちょうどいいです。
すごくコーティングされた感じでもなく、かといって革そのままという感じでもなく、
革そのものの質感がすごく良く見えます^^
（色は本当にすごく悩みました。4色全部気に入っていたのでㅠ_ㅠ）

2. 物ごとにちゃんと定位置があるバッグなんて？！

写真に載せたように、子どものもの＋自分のものをいつも一緒に入れている私のバッグにはポーチが必須だったのですが、収納がよく考えられていて、
それぞれ決まった場所にすっと入れられるので、ポーチがいらなくなりました！

クッションファンデの本体をなくしてしまって（笑）、リフィルだけ持ち歩いているのですが、リフィルとクッションがバッグの中で転がるので、これもポーチに入れて持ち歩いていました……。
でも専用のコンパクトポケットがあるので、そこにぴったり収まります！
しかもスペースが余るので、あぶらとり紙も一緒に入ります。

リップ製品用のポケットには、子どものためのお菓子を入れてみました。
お菓子もバッグの中で転がってしまうとベタベタして大変なんですよね。
それでこれもジップロックに入れて持ち歩いていたのですが、ポケットにすっと入れられるので便利です。

隠しバンドポケットには薬を入れておきました。
頭痛や胃もたれがあるので、いつも持ち歩かなければならないのですが、
ベナチオミニがすっぽり入りますし、意図したものではないと思いますが、ロゴのところにタイレノールを差しておくこともできます^^

（磁石もしっかりパチッと閉まります。磁力が弱くてゆるゆるだったり、ちゃんと閉まっているのか分からなかったりすることもありません）

さらに、ヘアゴムと、夏によく使う虫刺されパッチも一緒に入れました！

ジッパーポケットは写真を撮っていませんが、ライナーを入れるのにちょうどいいです。

そして隠しカードスリットに、バスや地下鉄に乗るときに使うカードを入れておけば、毎回財布を取り出す手間が省けます〜！

2つの拡張ボタンは、たくさん物を入れてもバッグ自体のフォルムがしっかりしているので、物が多すぎてバッグが今にもはち切れそう……という感じにならないのがいいです。
私は基本の状態で使っていますが、ボタンを開いて中に物を追加したり整理したりするときにも便利そうです^^

かなり大きく伸びます~~~~。しかも全然硬くありません！！

スナップボタンもとてもスムーズに閉まって、文句なしにいいです。
他のバッグだと、スナップを留めるときに指が赤くなるくらい強く押し込まないといけないこともありますが、
これは軽くトンと押すだけでカチッと閉まります！！

（サングラスも入ります^^ サングラスケースを入れるときは、広げて底にぴったり置くとちょうどいいです！）

＋夏の荷物（サングラス、シュシュ、リップ2本、クッション、あぶらとり紙、胃腸薬、タイレノール、ヘアゴム、お菓子2個、ライナー）

＋冬の荷物（カードウォレット、クッション、リップ2本、ウェットティッシュ、胃腸薬、タイレノール、ヘアゴム、お菓子2個、ライナー）

実際に両方入れてみましたが、全部入れても物のせいでバッグの形が崩れたり、パンパンに見えたりすることがありません^^
何も入れていないときと、たくさん詰めたときとで、
外から見た印象がほとんど変わらないんです〜！

底にはスタッズ（韓国では「鋲」と呼ぶそうです笑）が付いているので、汚れや傷もあまり気にせず使えそうです。
ブラックなので目立ちにくいですが、私が一番気になったバターカラーなら、かなり役立ちそうです。

3. いろいろなスタイリングができるストラップ

子どもたちと一緒のときは、優雅に持って歩く余裕なんてありません。
→ ベーシックストラップでクロスボディに！

友達に会うときはちょっとおしゃれしたい。
→ ショートチェーンストラップで肩掛けして、友達と腕を組んで〜

楽なのも大事だけど、可愛さも諦められないなら
→ ロングチェーンストラップで！！

（冬にコートやダウンジャケットのような厚手の服を着るときは、ロングチェーンのほうが楽そうです）

チェーンも全部購入したのは、やっぱり大正解でした^^

4. バッグへの細やかな配慮

大したことではないかもしれませんが、ダストバッグやパンフレット、
ターンロックを保護するためのビニール……というより、なんというか、とにかくカバーまで！
こういうところからも、配送や商品にまで細やかな気配りがされているんだなと感じました^^

＋Tip？

配送の影響でバッグのトートハンドルが少し曲がっていたのですが、
バッグの中に紙を丸めて入れておいたら（笑）、1日で元の形に戻りました！

＋あえて改善してほしい点を挙げるなら……^^

うーん、ストーリーを見たときもパンフレットを読んだときも感じたのですが、
作っている方は水色がお好きなのかな？ それとも
今回のコンセプトで水色をポイントカラーにされたのかな……。

バッグの中を開けると、まさに！！！ 濃い水色！！！！
私はもう少し淡い色か、ベージュ系の色のほうが、
さらに高級感があったんじゃないかなと思いました。

それから、サイドボタンのところにあるyyeonのロゴが、少しステッカーのように見えるのも気になりました。
革に押し込んだような型押しロゴだったらどうだったかな、と思います。
ブラックのバッグなのでゴールドのロゴがすごく目立つのですが、ステッカーのように見えるので、後から剥がれたり消えたりしないか少し心配でもあります。

次の製作では、この2点も検討してみていただけたら嬉しいです^^

今回の秋夕にプレゼントのように受け取ったので、連休中に出かけて、追加の写真もまたアップします〜^^

ーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーー

買い物に行くときは、カジュアルにクロスボディストラップに付け替えて使ってみましたが、カジュアルな服にもバッグがよく合います！

そして財布を持たずに、必要なカードを1枚だけ隠しカードスリットにスッと入れておけば、会計のときも便利ですね^^
text.EN:
Funding number 12748573

I fell in love with the photos at first sight, clicked through, read the story, signed up for notifications, set a calendar reminder, and kept looking at the additional photos posted before the launch. After going back and forth over it, I finally decided to back the Mellow Bag!

I have kids, so I always end up carrying a lot of things in my bag. I’ve graduated from using a diaper bag now, but I still carry both my kids’ things and my own, so having a pouch inside my bag was essential. With the Mellow Bag, though, I feel like I can finally leave behind the whole ‘I carry way too much stuff’ kind of bag^^

Here are the things I liked most...

1. It’s pretty. Really, really pretty!

Honestly, I practically backed this campaign just because of how pretty it is... The storage capacity is a bonus.
It’s just so pretty exactly as it looks in the photos.
Black with gold hardware! That’s basically a must-have combination, right?
A lot of bags have plating that’s too thin and ends up looking cheap, but this one is absolutely perfect!!! It’s a rich, deep gold💛

And the shine isn’t too strong; it’s just right.
It doesn’t feel overly coated, but it doesn’t feel like completely untreated leather either. The leather itself looks really nice^^
(I agonized over the color because I loved all four colors so muchㅠ_ㅠ)

2. A bag where every item has its own designated spot?!

As you can see in the photo, I always have both my kids’ things and my own in my bag, so I used to need a pouch. But the compartments are so thoughtfully arranged that I can simply put each item in its designated spot, so I don’t need a pouch anymore!

I lost the original case for my cushion foundation lol, so I only carry the refill now. The refill and cushion used to roll around in my bag, so I kept them in a pouch too... But there’s a dedicated compact pocket, and they fit perfectly in it!
There’s even enough room left over to fit some blotting paper too.

I put the kids’ candy in the lip-product pocket.
When candy rolls around in a bag, it gets sticky... It’s such a hassle.
So I used to carry it in a ziplock bag too, but it’s so much easier to just slip it into the pocket.

I put my medicine in the hidden elastic pocket.
I get headaches and indigestion, so I always need to carry medicine with me.
A small bottle of Venatio fits perfectly, and although I’m sure it wasn’t designed for this, I can even tuck a Tylenol packet into the logo area^^

(The magnet snaps shut securely with a click. There’s none of that weak, floppy magnetic closure where you’re not even sure whether the pocket is closed.)

I also put in a hair tie and some mosquito-bite patches that I find myself reaching for a lot in summer!

I didn’t take a separate photo of the zippered pocket, but it’s the perfect size for panty liners.

And if I put the card I need for the bus or subway in the hidden card slot, I don’t have to pull out my wallet every time~!

The two expansion buttons are great because even when I put a lot of things inside, the bag keeps its shape instead of looking like it’s about to burst from being overstuffed. I usually leave it in the standard setting, but I think opening the buttons would be convenient when I want to add more things or reorganize the contents^^

It stretches out really wide~~~~ and it isn’t stiff at all!!

The snap buttons close so smoothly too. Absolutely love them.
Some bags require you to press the snaps so hard that your fingers turn red just to get them closed properly, but with this one, you just give it a light tap and it snaps shut!!

(Sunglasses fit too^^ When putting in a sunglasses case, it works well to expand the bag and lay the case flat at the bottom!)

+ Summer essentials (sunglasses, scrunchie, 2 lip products, cushion compact, blotting paper, digestive medicine, Tylenol, hair tie, 2 candies, panty liner)

+ Winter essentials (card wallet, cushion compact, 2 lip products, wet wipes, digestive medicine, Tylenol, hair tie, 2 candies, panty liner)

I tried putting both sets inside, and even with everything packed in, the bag doesn’t look misshapen or overly stuffed^^
It looks almost exactly the same from the outside whether it’s empty or completely packed~!

There are protective studs on the bottom, so I won’t have to worry as much about stains or scratches. Since mine is black, they aren’t very noticeable, but I think they’d be especially useful on the Butter color, which was the one that caught my eye the most.

3. Straps that let you style it in different ways

When I’m out with my kids, I can’t exactly carry it elegantly.
→ Wear it crossbody with the basic strap!

When I’m meeting friends, I want to dress up a little.
→ Wear it on my shoulder with the short chain strap and walk arm-in-arm with my friends~

If comfort is important but you don’t want to give up the cute factor,
→ Go with the long chain strap!!

(The long chain seems like it would be more comfortable in winter when wearing thick clothes like a coat or padded jacket.)

Buying all the chain straps too was definitely the right choice^^

4. The thoughtful details

It may not seem like a big deal, but even the dust bag and pamphlet, and the cover for protecting the turn-lock closure—not exactly plastic, but whatever you’d call it!—made me feel that a lot of thought had gone into both the shipping and the product itself^^

+ Tip?

The tote handles were slightly bent from shipping, but I rolled up some paper and put it inside lol, and after a day they returned to their original shape!

+ If I had to mention anything I’d like to see improved... ^^

Hmm, I got this impression both from the story and the pamphlet, but I wonder whether the designers really like sky blue, or whether sky blue was simply meant to be the accent color for this concept..

When you open the bag, it’s exactly!!! a deep sky blue!!!!
I thought a much lighter shade or a beige tone might have looked a little more luxurious.

Also, the yyeon logo near the side button looks a little like a sticker, which is a bit disappointing. I wonder how it would have looked as a logo pressed directly into the leather instead. Since it’s a black bag, the gold logo really stands out, but because it looks a bit like a sticker, I’m slightly worried that it might peel or wear off later.

I think it would be great to consider these two points for the next production run^^

I received it like a gift this Chuseok, so I’m planning to go out during the holiday and upload some more photos~^^

ーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーー

When I went grocery shopping, I switched to the crossbody strap for a more casual look, and the bag goes really well with casual clothes too!

And instead of carrying a wallet, I can just slip the one card I need into the hidden card slot, which makes paying really convenient too^^

text.EN:
At first I was torn between vintage red and black, and I picked the safer black. But for some reason I kept feeling lingering regret over the butter beige and was a bit disappointed. Then I saw a news post on August 30th saying to contact them if I wanted a color change, so I thought 'maybe' and quickly reached out, and thankfully, they let me change the color...🥺🥺🥺❤️‍🔥❤️‍🔥
I waited eagerly for the shipping date, and I can't tell you how excited I was when the tracking number appeared🥹 And on the day it showed as delivered, I rushed home with my heart pounding, only to find it had been misdelivered to another house... It was late at night so there was nothing I could do, and I was really upset, but the next morning someone brought the package back from the wrong house🥹 They had already opened and checked the contents so I didn't get to experience the thrill of unwrapping it myself, but my heart was still racing plenty🥹💖💖
I ordered the short chain along with it! The basic chain gives off a clean, elegant look, while the short chain gave a bit more of a glamorous, feminine feel💓💓
I checked the size before ordering, but when I actually received it, it was even more compact than expected, and I briefly wondered if the storage would be enough..? But even after fitting in my usual minimal essentials - compact, 4 lip products, 2 blushes, sun stick, 3 stick cosmetics, hand mirror, wireless earbuds, and hand cream - there was still plenty of room left, enough to fit more😯😯 This bag felt designed not just to have vaguely huge storage, but to let you efficiently pack and organize items to maximize the use of limited space💕
The pocket with the flap has some kind of elastic band? part that stretches, so it holds things in place decently, meaning I could confidently put in blush or eyeshadow, and probably perfume too🤔 The small inner pocket inside the compact storage pocket seems good for cards I don't take out often, and the outer pocket seems convenient for the cards I use frequently💖👍
The beige color really is exactly a buttery beige, soft and clean. I don't regret changing the color at the last minute at all. It's really not just any beige. It's a soft color that the name 'Butter Beige' suits perfectly🥹💓
The light color for everyday carrying, the simple yet distinctive design, is just so so pretty..🥺💖❤️‍🔥 It's bright and pure in a way that matches my aesthetic well, and the design isn't overdone so it goes with almost any outfit, I really love it🥺🥺❤️‍🔥❤️‍🔥
Honestly this is my first time buying a bag like this so I'm not sure what would be considered lacking. But looking all over the bag, I didn't find anything that particularly bothered me~
I'm really happy to have gotten such a pretty bag🥹 If there's ever a re-funding round, that's when I'll definitely!!! buy the vintage red😖💖 I hope to use it for a long time, and I'll cherish and treasure it well❤️‍🔥~~~

흐물흐물해서 짐 막 집어넣을 수 있는 보부상가방,  조금 더 저렴한 가격대의 제품 등 다양한 제품 만나 볼 수 있을까요. 앞으로도 계속해서 더 나은 좋은 제품 많이 만들어주세요 :) 😀 
다가오는 추석연휴 즐겁고 행복하세요.
text.JA:
既存の1次ブルーミングバッグと新しく届いたメロウバッグ🧡💛
到着記念に一緒に撮ってみました。
四季通して掛けられる色かどうか悩んだんですが、実際受け取ってみると意外と大丈夫そうです。満足しています。色がなんでこんなに綺麗なんでしょう？🥺
本品はプレゼントとしてもらって私はストラップだけ別に購入したんですが、まだストラップは届いていなくて残念ですが...😢 とりあえず出してみました。
確実にサイズの差があります。コンパクトで形がしっかりしていて可愛い..
普段からもう少し小さいバッグも掛けてみたかったんです。荷物多めなのでブルーミングも膨らんで閉めにくくて悩んでいたんですが.....横に拡張できるということでメロウバッグはどうなるか一生懸命テトリスしてみました。
ブルーミングバッグはリップ収納が3つですが正直3つ全部使いきれていないので...サイズが小さい分必要なものだけきっちり持ち歩かないと🤔と思っています。緑の財布以外は写真にある荷物全部入ります。
でも開け閉めして一日で傷がついてしまいました...
ブルーミングのスナップが一発で閉まらないことがあって、開け閉めはメロウのほうが便利ですが拡張するとうまく閉まりません😮
私がバッグを選ぶ基準は内部ポケットが必ず2つ以上あること、ジッパーポケットが必ずあることですが、サイズが小さくても必要なものが全部揃っていていいです。
こうやってミニミの商品が出たので、もう少し大きいバッグも今後会えるかもしれませんね😂
出勤時は雑多なものを全部詰め込まないといけないので、遊びに行く時にブルーミングを使って、メロウも早く掛けて遊びに行きたいです。
くたっと柔らかくて荷物をどんどん入れられる荷物多め用バッグ、もう少しお手頃な価格帯の商品など、いろんな商品に出会えたら嬉しいです。これからもずっとより良い商品をたくさん作ってください:) 😀
迫ってくる秋夕の連休、楽しく幸せにお過ごしください。
text.EN:
My existing first Blooming bag and the newly arrived Mellow bag🧡💛
Took a photo together to celebrate the arrival.
I wondered if this color could be worn year-round, but having received it, it seems surprisingly fine. I'm satisfied. Why is the color so pretty?🥺
I got the main item as a gift and ordered just the strap separately, but the strap hasn't arrived yet which is a bit disappointing...😢 For now I took it out to look.
There's definitely a size difference. Compact and structured, cute..
I'd been wanting to try a slightly smaller bag. Since I'm a heavy packer the Blooming bag would bulge and be hard to close, so I was worried.....but hearing it can expand on the side I tried hard to Tetris things into the Mellow bag to see how it'd go.
The Blooming bag has 3 lip storage slots but honestly I can't use all 3 anyway...so since it's smaller I think I need to just carry only what's absolutely necessary🤔 Everything in the photo fits except the green wallet.
But it got scratched from opening and closing within a single day...
The Blooming's snap sometimes doesn't close on the first try, so opening and closing is more convenient with the Mellow, but it doesn't close well when expanded😮
My criteria for choosing a bag are that it must have at least 2 inner pockets and a zip pocket, and even though this is small it has everything I need, which is great.
Since a mini version like this came out, maybe we'll see a bigger bag in the future too😂
Since I have to pack all sorts of odds and ends for work, I want to use the Blooming when going out to play, and hurry up and wear the Mellow out to play too.
A soft, slouchy heavy-packer bag you can just stuff things into, more products at a slightly more affordable price point, I hope to see a variety of products like these. Please keep making even better products going forward:) 😀
Hope you have a fun and happy upcoming Chuseok holiday.

text.KO:
생일이 일주일도 안 남았는데 선물같이 도착한 멜로우백!
정말 예쁜 버터같은 색감이예요💛
끝까지 갈색과 고민하다가 흔하지 않은 요 아이로 골랐는데 탁월한 선택이었어요.😆
안쪽 하늘색 배색까지 완전 내 스타일🩵

미니백을 좋아해서 가방들이 다 작은편이고
그러면 수납이 항상 아쉬워서 손에 들고 다니거나 두고 다니는 물건들이 생기기 마련인데
와우! 연장도 하지 않은 상태에서 이 수납력 머선일이고!

반지갑, 장바구니, 차키, 인공눈물, 썬쿠션, 립스틱, 커다란 하이라이터, 보조배터리, 마지막으로 무려 미니 손 선풍기까지!
이게 다~ 연장 안 한 기본 상태로 들어간다는 말씀.
그렇게 들어가고도 아직 여유있는거 실화예요?
보기에 쬐끔 거시기해도 가방 고리에 손 선풍기 대롱대롱 매달고 다니던 날들은 이제 안녕.🤭

착샷은 160cm 6학년 꼬맹이가 찍어보았어요.
보자마자 예쁘다며 엄마 가방을 탐내네요.🤣
키는 비슷하고 옆으로는 더 큰 제가 착용했을때는
크로스 끈을 가장 길게 했을때가 예뻤고,
키만 크고 마른 꼬맹이는 두칸정도 줄이니 적당히 보기 좋았어요.👍

다음에 또 기회가 온다면 마지막까지 고민했던 갈색으로 추가구매 할 생각입니다. 
디자인도 수납력도 모두 갖춘 멜로우백, 
만들어주셔서 정말 감사합니다.😊
text.JA:
誕生日まで1週間もないのにプレゼントのように届いたメロウバッグ!
本当に綺麗なバターのような色味です💛
最後まで茶色と悩んで、あまり見かけないこの子を選んだんですが最高の選択でした😆
内側の水色の配色まで完全に私好み🩵
ミニバッグが好きなのでバッグが全部小さめなんですが
そうすると収納がいつも物足りなくて手に持ったり置いていく物が出てくるものですが
わあ！拡張もしていない状態でこの収納力、どういうことでしょう!
三つ折り財布、買い物袋、車の鍵、目薬、サンクッション、口紅、大きめのハイライター、モバイルバッテリー、最後になんとミニ携帯扇風機まで!
これ全部〜拡張していない基本状態で入るということです。
それでも入れてまだ余裕があるのが本当ですか？
ちょっと見た目が微妙でも、バッグのフックに扇風機をぶら下げて歩いていた日々よ、さようなら。🤭
着用写真は160cm小学6年生の子供が撮ってくれました。
見た瞬間可愛いと言って私のバッグを欲しがっています🤣
身長は似ていて横幅は私のほうが大きいんですが、私が着用した時は
クロスストラップを一番長くした時が綺麗で、
背が高くて細身の子どもは2段階くらい短くしたらちょうど良く見えました👍
次にまた機会が来たら最後まで悩んでいた茶色を追加購入するつもりです。
デザインも収納力も全部備えたメロウバッグ、
作ってくださって本当にありがとうございます😊
text.EN:
With less than a week left before my birthday, the Mellow bag arrived like a present!
Such a pretty butter-like color💛
I agonized until the very end between this and brown, and chose this less common color, which turned out to be the best choice😆
Even the sky blue color combo inside is exactly my style🩵
I love mini bags so all my bags are on the small side
but then storage is always lacking and I end up carrying things by hand or leaving things behind
wow! I'm amazed at this storage capacity even without expanding it!
A half wallet, shopping bag, car key, eye drops, sun cushion, lipstick, a big highlighter, mobile battery, and finally even a mini handheld fan!
All of that~ fits in the basic unexpanded state.
And it still has room to spare after all that, is that even real?
Even if it looked a bit awkward before, those days of hanging a fan off my bag hook are officially over.🤭
The modeling photo was taken by my 160cm, 6th-grade child.
The moment she saw it she said it's cute and now wants my bag🤣
Our heights are similar though I'm wider, and when I wear it,
it looked prettiest with the crossbody strap at its longest,
while for my tall, skinny kid, shortening it by about 2 notches looked just right👍
If another chance comes up I plan to buy the brown one I agonized over until the end, as an additional purchase.
The Mellow bag, which has both design and storage capacity,
thank you so much for making it😊

text.KO:
기다리던 그 가방이 도착했어요! 제 주머니가 되어줄 가방! 
받아보니 생각보다 작고 통통한 가방이라 놀랐어요. 역시 수납력이 좋으려면 얇을 수 없겠죠 통통한게 너무 귀여우면서도 깔끔함도 놓치지 않아 데일리백으로 정말 좋다는 생각이 들었어요. 
이 넉넉함 보이시나요,, 저는 피부화장을 막 열심히 하지 않고 팩트보다는 선크림을 유용하게 사용하는 편이에요. 그래서 팩트가 들어갈 공간에 무선이어폰과 안경닦이를 넣었어요 ㅎㅎ 자주 쓰는게 열자마자 보이고 찾기도 쉬우니까 확실히 편하더라고요. 
언제 터질 지 모르지만 가지고 다니기는 애매한 생리대도 하나 넣었는데 티도 안나지 않나요? 안보여서 그런지 용량에도 큰 차이가 없게 느껴져서 데일리하게 가지고 다닐 수 있다는 점이 정말 여성을 위한 백이라는게 여실히 느껴졌어요🥹 
아무래도 가방 자체가 컴팩트한 사이즈라서 제 긴 브러쉬들은 바닥에 두어야 했지만,, 수정화장을 하려면 어차피 화장품도 다 꺼내야 하니 상관없겠다 싶은 마음도 들었어요. 
저는 약한 지병 때문에 언제 필요할 지 몰라 약을 항상 가지고 다녀야 하는데요, 저 립스틱과 팩트 뒤 공간에 제 약들이 쏙 들어가더라고요! 급할 때 쬐꼬만 약들 찾느라 가방 탈탈 털지 않아도 되고 평소에 가방을 열었을때 약이 보일 일도 없어서 마음에 들었어요. 저같은 분이 아니어도 상비약이나 발 다쳤을 때를 대비한 밴드 같은거 넣어두셔도 좋을 것 같고요. 약은 보통 급할 때 필요한 법이잖아요ㅜ 
앞쪽의 카드 주머니에는 제일 자주 쓰는 카드랑 신분증까지 두장 딱 들어가더라고요! 뒤쪽 주머니에는 급하게 핸드폰 들고 있다 잠시 손에서 놔야 할 때 꽂아두기 좋을 거 같아요. 다른분들께도 제 사용법을 알려드리고 싶어서 케이스만 넣고 한장 찍어보았어요 ㅎㅎ
여성복엔 주머니가 없는 경우가 많아서 곤란할 때 많잖아요ㅜ 그렇다고 가방들을 들고 다니자니 이렇게 구역이 세분화된 가방은 잘 없어서 또 가방 안에서 물건 찾는데 한참이고.. 늘 가지고 다녀야 할 필요한 것들은 또 왜이렇게 많은지. 그렇다고 큰 가방을 들기에는 꾸민 옷과 어울리지 않거나 다니기 불편할 때가 많았어요. 주머니처럼 작다고 할 수는 없지만 일반적인 가방보다는 작으면서 이렇게 필요한건 다 찾기 쉽게 들어가니까 앞으로 이 가방이 제 주머니처럼 쓰일 거 같아요🥰 앞으로도 여성들을 위한 백이 더 고려돼서 나오면 정말 좋을 거 같아요 좋은 가방 감사해요💕

사진 이렇게 잘려서 5장밖에 못올라가는거 쪼금 아쉽네요🥹 진짜 예쁭데... 이사진보다 더 예쁘게 나왔는데.. 예쁜사진 진짜 많은데....
text.JA:
待っていたそのバッグが届きました！私のポケットになってくれるバッグ！
受け取ってみると思ったより小さくてぽってりしたバッグで驚きました。やはり収納力が良いには薄くはできませんよね、ぽってりしているのがすごく可愛くてすっきりさもなくさないのでデイリーバッグとして本当に良いと思いました。
この余裕見えますか,,私はスキンメイクをあまり熱心にするほうではなくパクトよりも日焼け止めを便利に使うほうです。それでパクトが入るはずのスペースにワイヤレスイヤホンと眼鏡拭きを入れました笑 よく使う物が開けた瞬間見えて探しやすいのが確かに便利でした。
いつ来るか分からないけど持ち歩くには微妙な生理用ナプキンも一つ入れましたが、目立たないですよね？見えないからか容量にも大きな差がないように感じられて、デイリーに持ち歩けるという点が本当に女性のためのバッグだと実感できました🥹
やはりバッグ自体がコンパクトなサイズなので私の長いブラシは底に置かないといけませんでしたが,,直しメイクをするならどうせ化粧品も全部出さないといけないので構わないという気持ちにもなりました。
私は軽い持病のせいでいつ必要になるか分からず薬を常に持ち歩かないといけないんですが、あのリップとパクトの後ろのスペースに私の薬がすっと入ったんです！急いでいる時ちっちゃい薬を探すのにバッグをひっくり返す必要もないですし、普段バッグを開けた時に薬が見える心配もないので気に入りました。私みたいな方じゃなくても常備薬や足を怪我した時のための絆創膏のようなものを入れておいてもいいと思いますし。薬は普通急いでいる時に必要になるものじゃないですか(涙)
前面のカードポケットには一番よく使うカードと身分証まで2枚ぴったり入りました！後ろのポケットには急いで携帯を持っていて一時的に手から離さないといけない時に差しておくのに良さそうです。他の方にも私の使い方をお伝えしたくてケースだけ入れて1枚撮ってみました笑
女性服にはポケットがない場合が多くて困ることが多いじゃないですか(涙) だからといってバッグを持ち歩くにはこんなに区画が細分化されたバッグはあまりなくて、またバッグの中で物を探すのに時間がかかって..いつも持ち歩かないといけない必要な物はまたなんでこんなに多いんでしょう。かといって大きいバッグを持つには着飾った服に合わなかったり持ち歩くのに不便だったりすることが多かったです。ポケットほど小さいとは言えませんが一般的なバッグより小さくてこんなに必要な物が全部見つけやすく入るので、これからこのバッグが私のポケットのように使われそうです🥰 これからも女性のためのバッグがもっと考慮されて出てほしいです。良いバッグをありがとうございます💕
写真がこうやって切れて5枚しかアップできないのがちょっと残念です🥹 本当に綺麗なのに...この写真よりもっと綺麗に撮れたのに..綺麗な写真本当に多いのに....
text.EN:
The bag I'd been waiting for has arrived! A bag that will become my pocket!
When I received it I was surprised it was smaller and chubbier than expected. I guess good storage capacity means it can't be thin - the chubbiness is really cute while still staying neat, so I thought it would be really great as a daily bag.
Can you see this roominess,, I'm not the type to do heavy skin makeup and I find sunscreen more useful than compact powder. So I put my wireless earbuds and glasses cloth in the space meant for a compact haha Having frequently used items visible and easy to find the moment I open it was definitely convenient.
I also put in one sanitary pad, which I never know when I'll need but is awkward to carry around, and can you even tell it's there? Since it's not visible, it feels like there's no big difference in capacity either, and being able to carry it daily really made me feel this is truly a bag made for women🥹
Since the bag itself is compact, I had to lay my long brushes flat at the bottom,, but I figured it doesn't matter since I'd have to take out all my cosmetics anyway for touch-up makeup.
I have a mild chronic condition so I need to carry medicine with me at all times since I never know when I'll need it, and it fit perfectly into the space behind the lip and compact pockets! No need to flip the whole bag upside down looking for tiny pills when I'm in a hurry, and I don't have to worry about the medicine being visible whenever I open my bag normally, so I liked that. Even for people not like me, it seems good for keeping first-aid items or bandages for foot injuries. Medicine is usually something you need in a hurry, right(sob)
The front card pocket fit exactly two cards - my most-used card and my ID! The back pocket seems good for tucking away your phone when you're in a rush and need to free up your hand temporarily. I wanted to share how I use it with others so I took a photo with just the case in it haha
Women's clothes often don't have pockets, which is frustrating a lot of the time(sob) But then carrying a bag, there aren't many bags with compartments this detailed, so I'd waste time searching inside the bag..and why are there always so many essentials I need to carry with me anyway. On the other hand, carrying a big bag often didn't match dressed-up outfits or was inconvenient to carry. It's not quite as small as a pocket, but it's smaller than a typical bag while still fitting everything I need in an easy-to-find way, so I think this bag will end up being used like my pocket from now on🥰 I hope more bags designed with women in mind keep coming out. Thank you for a great bag💕
It's a bit disappointing that the photos got cropped like this and only 5 could be uploaded🥹 It's really pretty though...I have shots that came out even prettier than these..so many pretty photos really....

text.KO: 많이 기대했는데 생각보다 별로인점이 보이네요. 일단 디자인은 마음에 드는데 가방이 큰 만큼 그냥 손에 들고다니면 무겁기에 항상 크로스로 백을 메고 다니는데 이 가방도 끈이있어서 매력을 느껴주문했습니다. 근데 받으신 분들은 아시겠지만 손잡이 부분이 안내려가요. 원래 다른 가장들은 크로스로 맬때 자연스럽게 내려가는데 이건 손잡이 부분이 매우 빡빡 하다고 해야하나 손잡이 부분에 그냥 접힌 부분도 없는 가죽으로만 되어있어 크로스로 사용할때 매우 불편해요. 걸리적거리고 그래서 다시 내용을 찾아보니 크로스로 맨 사진은 역시 많지않더라구요. 그냥 들면 참 이쁘고 많이 들어가지만 상당히 비싼 가격인데 이러한 부분이 아쉬워서 그냥 손으로 들고다닐때만 자주 사용할거같아요.
text.JA: すごく期待していたんですが思ったより残念な点が見えます。まずデザインは気に入っているんですが、バッグが大きい分そのまま手に持つと重いので、いつもクロスでバッグを掛けているんですが、このバッグもストラップがあって魅力を感じて注文しました。でも受け取った方はご存知の通り、持ち手部分が倒れません。他のバッグは普通クロスで掛ける時自然に倒れるんですが、これは持ち手部分がすごく硬いというか、持ち手部分に折れ目もない革だけでできていてクロスで使う時すごく不便です。引っかかったりして、それで他のレビューを探してみたんですが、クロスで掛けた写真は確かに多くありませんでした。手に持てば本当に綺麗でたくさん入りますが、結構高い価格なのにこの部分が残念で、手に持つ時だけよく使うことになりそうです。
text.EN: I had high expectations but there are more disappointing points than expected. First, I like the design, but since the bag is big, carrying it by hand is heavy, so I always wear my bags crossbody, and this bag has a strap so I found it appealing and ordered it. But as anyone who's received it knows, the handle part doesn't fold down. Other bags naturally fold down when worn crossbody, but this one's handle is really stiff, or rather, it's made entirely of leather with no crease at all in the handle, making it really inconvenient when worn crossbody. It catches on things, so I looked for other reviews and indeed there weren't many photos of it worn crossbody. Held by hand it's really pretty and holds a lot, but this is a fairly expensive bag and this issue is disappointing, so I think I'll mostly end up using it only carried by hand.

text.KO: 보부상에게 적합하게 가볍고 딥브라운 색상도 마음에 듭니다. 다만, 몇 가지 아쉬운 부분도 있네요. 사이드 오픈 포켓에도 히든 자석 스냅처리가 되어 있었으면 더 좋았을것 같아요.  포켓이 모양을 잡아줘도 자꾸 벌어지고 파란 안감이 눈에 띄여서 신경쓰이네요.   롱 스트랩은 편하고 견고한 것 같은데, 가방과 연결되는 부분이 좀 약한 것 같아요. 숄더백으로도 자주 사용할 것 같은데, 연결부위가 가방 무게를 버티지 못하고 찢어지지는 않을까 걱정됩니다. 예전에 가죽 가방이 스트랩과 고리는 멀쩡한데, 연결 고리가 있는 가방 부위가 찢어져서 수선하느라 고생한 적이 있어서요. 그래도 전반적으로는 마음에 듭니다.
text.JA: 荷物多め用として適度に軽くてディープブラウンの色も気に入っています。ただ、いくつか残念な部分もあります。サイドのオープンポケットにも隠し磁石のスナップ処理があればもっと良かったと思います。ポケットが形を保っていてもよく開いてしまい、青い裏地が目立って気になります。ロングストラップは快適で丈夫そうですが、バッグと連結される部分が少し弱い気がします。ショルダーバッグとしても頻繁に使いそうなんですが、連結部分がバッグの重さに耐えきれず裂けてしまわないか心配です。以前革バッグでストラップとフックは無事だったのに、フックがある部分のバッグ本体が裂けて修理に苦労したことがあるので。それでも全体的には気に入っています。
text.EN: It's appropriately light for heavy packers and I like the deep brown color too. However, there are a few disappointing points. The side open pocket would've been better with a hidden magnet snap too. Even though the pocket holds its shape, it keeps opening and the blue lining catching my eye bothers me. The long strap feels comfortable and sturdy, but the part connecting to the bag feels a bit weak. I think I'll use it as a shoulder bag often too, and I'm worried the connection point might tear from the bag's weight over time. I once had a leather bag where the strap and hook were fine but the bag itself tore where the hook attached, and I had a hard time getting it repaired. Still, overall I like it.

text.KO: 가방은 정말 마음에 들어요. 노트북 들고 다니기도 편할것같구요. 다만 이번에 지연된건 조금 아쉬웠습니다.
text.JA: バッグは本当に気に入っています。ノートパソコンを持ち歩くのにも便利そうです。ただ今回遅延があったのは少し残念でした。
text.EN: I really love the bag. It also seems convenient for carrying a laptop. Just the delay this time was a bit disappointing.

text.KO:
색은 완전 예상대로입니다 맘에 들어요! 가죽도 탄탄하고 부드러워서 좋았습니다! 디자인 적인 부분에서는 손잡이 부분이 생각보다 길어서 손으로 들거나 팔에 걸치기에 좀 부담스럽습니다. 양옆에 가방끈을 걸어서 매보니 그  손잡이가 거추장스럽습니다....
노트북이 들어갈만한 사이즈라 어느정도 크기를 생각하긴 했는데 그 이상이네요.. 
튼튼한 출근 가방으로는 좋습니다!
text.JA:
色は完全に想像通りです、気に入っています！革もしっかりしていて柔らかくて良かったです！デザイン的な部分では持ち手部分が思ったより長くて、手に持ったり腕に掛けたりするのが少し負担です。両サイドにストラップを掛けて使ってみると、その持ち手が邪魔になります....
ノートパソコンが入るくらいのサイズだとある程度想像していましたが、それ以上ですね..
しっかりした出勤バッグとしては良いです！
text.EN:
The color is exactly as expected, I like it! The leather is also solid and soft, which was nice! Design-wise, the handle part is longer than expected, making it a bit of a burden to carry by hand or drape over my arm. When I use it with the strap attached on both sides, that handle gets in the way....
I had somewhat imagined a size that would fit a laptop, but it's even bigger than that..
It's good as a sturdy commuting bag though!

text.KO: 평소에 이제품 관심있게 보고 있는데 배송기간이 좀 많이 지연되었지만 그럼에도 불구하고 덕분에 그때 구매하길 잘했다는 생각이 듭니다^^ 회사에  출근할 때 들고 가기 적당한 크기라서 수납력도 나쁘지 않아서 괜찮아요 아쉬운건 배송 지연될 때 미리공지 해주시면 감사하겠습니다 ㅠㅠ 그러나 물건 받을때 하자없이 와서 다행이라고 생각듭니다 감사히 잘 받을게요~
text.JA: 普段この商品を興味を持って見ていたんですが、配送期間が結構長引いてしまいましたが、それでもおかげであの時買ってよかったと思います^^ 会社に出勤する時に持って行くのにちょうどいいサイズなので収納力も悪くなくていいです。残念なのは配送が遅延する時は事前にお知らせいただけたら嬉しいです(涙涙) でも受け取った商品に不具合がなくて幸いだったと思います。感謝して大切に受け取りました〜
text.EN: I'd been eyeing this product for a while, and the shipping period was delayed quite a bit, but even so I think it was a good decision to buy it back then^^ It's just the right size to carry to work so the storage isn't bad, good. What's disappointing is I wish there had been advance notice about the shipping delay(sob sob) But I'm glad the product I received had no defects. I received it gratefully with care~

text.KO:
예쁘고, 물건이 깔끔하게 들어가서 만족해요.
원래 들고 다녔던 가방과 비교하면 정말 천지차이예요.ㅋ
어깨에 맸을때 좀 여유가 없는 감이 있긴하지만 봤을 때 어색하진 않아요.
가방이 벌어지지 않게 고정해주는 고리는 체결하고 풀기가 좀 어렵네요. 안쓸 것 같아요.

전체적으로 물건 정리가 잘 되고 모양도 흐트러지지 않아 업무용으로 잘 들고 다닐 것 같습니다. 배송이 좀 더 빨랐으면 더 좋았겠습니다^^
사은품으로 주신 반지케이스는 귀여워서 딸이 가져갔네요^^ 감사합니다.
사진은 세로로 찍었는데 가로로 첨부돼서 전체샷이 안들어가서 아쉽네요.

작은 가방에는 인덱스랑 밴드 등 자질구레한 걸 넣을 수 있어서 좋네요. 수납력 진짜 짱이예요!!!!
text.JA:
綺麗で、物がすっきり収納できて満足しています。
もともと持ち歩いていたバッグと比べると本当に天と地の差です笑
肩に掛けた時少し余裕がない感じはありますが、見た目には違和感ありません。
バッグが開かないよう固定してくれるフックは締めたり外したりするのが少し難しいです。使わなさそうです。
全体的に物の整理がしやすく形も崩れないので仕事用によく持ち歩けそうです。配送がもう少し早ければもっと良かったです^^
ノベルティでいただいた指輪ケースは可愛くて娘が持って行きました^^ありがとうございます。
写真は縦で撮ったんですが横向きで添付されて全体ショットが入らなくて残念です。
小さいバッグにはインデックスやバンドなどこまごましたものを入れられていいです。収納力本当に最高です!!!!
text.EN:
It's pretty, everything stores neatly, and I'm satisfied.
Compared to the bag I used to carry it's like night and day haha
When worn on the shoulder it feels a bit snug, but it doesn't look odd.
The hook that keeps the bag from gaping open is a bit hard to fasten and unfasten. I probably won't use it.
Overall it's easy to keep things organized and it holds its shape, so it seems great for carrying to work. It would've been even better if shipping were a bit faster^^
The ring case I got as a novelty item was cute so my daughter took it^^ Thank you.
I took the photo vertically but it got attached horizontally so the full shot didn't come through, a bit disappointing.
The small bag lets me carry little odds and ends like index cards and bands, love it. The storage capacity is really the best!!!!

text.KO:
(거울더러움주의) 멜로우백 한 달 사용후기입니다! 가방을 두 개 사서 후기도 하나 더 쓸 수 있는 줄 알고 올릴 사진을 열 장 추려왔는데 후기는 하나밖에 못쓰네요ㅜㅜ 후기 하나당 사진 5개가 최대라 아쉽지만 이거라도 올려봐요 (가방 착샷은 왼쪽부터 순서대로 숏-롱-기본 스트랩 순입니당)

1. 디자인
상세페이지 사진만 봐도 알 수 있듯이 당연히 너무너무 예쁘구요😍 들고나갈때마다 주변에서 어디 가방이냐구 계속 물어봐서 yyeon 인스타 알려주고 열심히 홍보하고 다녔어요ㅎㅎ 엄마도 보자마자 가방 너무 이쁘다구 하시더라구요! 정말 감사하게도 지난 이벤트에 당첨됐었는데 또 마침 보내주신 월넛 브라운 컬러가 저희 엄마 최애 컬러여서 이벤트로 받은 멜로우백은 엄마 드렸어요(yyeon 덕분에 효도했어요 감사해요💗) 처음에 받고 놀랐던건 생각보다 가방이 작다는거? 손바닥 두개로 가려지는 미니사이즈여서 앙증맞고 귀엽고 좋았는데 내부 수납공간은 받기 전에 생각했던 사이즈 그대로 넉넉해서 너무 신기했어요..! 외관은 세 컬러 다 이쁜데 블랙이 특히! 광택이 나서 제일 이뻤고 사진이 실물을 다 못담는거 같아요 제 최애 컬러입니다❤️
+ 아 체인스트랩은 꼭 가방이랑 같이 구매하시는걸 추천드려요 진짜진짜진짜×100000000 이쁘고 가방이랑 잘 어울립니당

2. 코디
차려입고 나가야되는 날에는 체인스트랩, 캐주얼하게 입을때는 기본스트랩이 잘 어울리더라구요! 사진처럼 그냥 평범하게 티에 데님스커트만 입어도 체인스트랩이랑 같이 매치해주면 나름 신경쓴 코디처럼 훨씬 고급스러워지구요, 꾸꾸꾸 코디일때는 더더욱 멜로우백에 체인스트랩까지 걸어주고 나가야 완성이에요. 반대로 캐주얼(이 아니라 후줄근...)하게 입고 산책 나갈때도 기본 스트랩 걸어서 매주면 부담스럽지 않게 맬 수 있으면서도 가방이 이쁘다 보니 제 몰골이 상쇄?되어서 너무 추레하지 않고 깔끔하게 나갈수 있더라구요ㅋㅋ 꾸밀때든 아닐때든 언제든지 데일리로 들고다닐수 있어서 너무 좋았고 더군다나 저는 세컬러나 있어서 그날그날 옷 색깔에 어울리는 컬러로 들고나갈수 있어서 최고였습니다👍👍 범용성이 좋아서 요즘 일주일 내내 멜로우백만 매고 다녀요ㅎㅎ

3. 수납력
사실 받기 전에도 이미 헨느백과 블루밍백을 전부 써본 사람으로서 수납력은 당연히 좋을거라는 걸 알고는 있었지만 실제로 써보니 생각보다도 더 많이 들어가서 놀랐어요. 사진 찍은거는 가방 완전 꽉 채운것도 아니고 공간 조금 남겨놓은 건데도 똑딱이 오픈해서 확장하니까 저만큼이나 들어가더라구요. 다만 아코디언 기능? 쓰면 뚜껑 닫는게 좀 빡세긴 해요 물론 그래도 닫히긴 잘 닫히구요, 지퍼포켓은 생리대는 안들어가고 팬티라이너 딱 두개까지 들어가는거 참고하세요! 파우치포켓에는 블러셔랑 립밤 이렇게 두개정도 딱 들어가요. 폰은 제가 플립6를 쓰는데 플립은 완전 넉넉하게 들어가고 바형 핸드폰도 갤럭시 울트라나 아이폰 프로 시리즈만 아니면 무리없이 들어가지 않을까 싶습니다(울트라나 프로도 들어갈수도?) 카드 포켓에는 딱 카드 하나만 들어가긴 하는데 보기와는 다르게 전혀 뻑뻑하지 않고 카드 넣다뺐다 하기 편했어요!

4. 기타
지난 펀딩때 후기에 금장까짐이나 본드자국 등등 이슈가 있어서 저도 사실 조금은 걱정했는데 이번에는 많이 개선하셨는지 저는 그런 이슈 전혀 없었습니다! 마감도 깔끔하구요ㅎㅎ 앞으로 구매하실분들 걱정 안하셔도 될것 같습니당 :)
text.JA:
（鏡の汚れご注意）メロウバッグ1ヶ月使用後記です！バッグを2個買ったのでレビューをもう一つ書けると思って写真を10枚選んでいたんですが、レビューは1つしか書けないんですね(涙) レビュー1つにつき写真5枚が上限で残念ですが、これだけでもアップしてみます（着用写真は左から順にショート-ロング-基本ストラップの順です）
1. デザイン
詳細ページの写真だけでも分かるように当然すごくすごく綺麗です😍 持って出かけるたびに周りからどこのバッグかとずっと聞かれて、yyeonのインスタを教えてしっかり宣伝してきました笑 母も見た瞬間バッグすごく綺麗だと言ってくれました！本当にありがたいことに以前のイベントに当選したんですが、ちょうど送っていただいたウォルナットブラウンカラーが母の一番好きな色だったので、イベントでもらったメロウバッグは母にあげました（yyeonのおかげで親孝行できました、ありがとうございます💗）最初に受け取って驚いたのは思ったよりバッグが小さいこと？両手のひらで隠れるくらいのミニサイズで可愛らしくて良かったんですが、内部の収納スペースは受け取る前に想像していたサイズそのままに余裕があってすごく不思議でした..! 外観は3色とも綺麗ですが特にブラックが！艶があって一番綺麗で、写真じゃ実物を全部表現しきれない気がします。私の一番好きな色です❤️
+ あ、チェーンストラップは必ずバッグと一緒に購入することをおすすめします、本当に本当に本当に×100000000綺麗でバッグにすごく合います
2. コーディネート
きちんと着飾って出かける日はチェーンストラップ、カジュアルに着る時は基本ストラップがよく似合いました！写真のようにただ普通にTシャツにデニムスカートだけ着てもチェーンストラップと合わせるとそれなりに気を配ったコーデのようにずっと高級感が出ますし、めかしこんだコーデの時はさらにメロウバッグにチェーンストラップまで掛けて出かけてこそ完成です。逆にカジュアル（というより着崩れた感じ...）に着て散歩に出かける時も基本ストラップを掛ければ負担なく持てる上にバッグが綺麗なので私の見た目が相殺？されて、あまりくたびれた感じにならずすっきり出かけられます笑 めかしこんでもそうじゃなくてもいつでもデイリーで持ち歩けてすごく良かったですし、しかも私は3色も持っているのでその日その日の服の色に合う色を選んで持ち歩けて最高でした👍👍 汎用性が良くて最近1週間ずっとメロウバッグばかり掛けています笑
3. 収納力
実は受け取る前からすでにヘンヌバッグとブルーミングバッグを両方使った人間として収納力は当然良いだろうと分かってはいたんですが、実際使ってみたら思ったよりさらにたくさん入って驚きました。写真を撮ったのはバッグを完全にぎっしり詰めたわけでもなくて空間を少し残しておいたものですが、スナップを開けて拡張すればあれだけ入ります。ただアコーディオン機能？を使うと蓋を閉めるのがちょっと大変です。もちろんそれでも閉まりはちゃんと閉まりますし、ジッパーポケットは生理用ナプキンは入らずパンティライナーがちょうど2枚まで入るので参考にしてください！ポーチポケットにはチークとリップバームこの2つがちょうど入ります。携帯は私はFlip6を使っているんですが、Flipは完全に余裕で入りますし、バー型の携帯もGalaxy UltraやiPhone Proシリーズでなければ問題なく入るんじゃないかと思います（UltraやProも入るかも？）カードポケットにはカード1枚だけしか入りませんが見た目と違って全然硬くなくてカードの出し入れが楽でした！
4. その他
前回のファンディングのレビューで金具の剥げやボンドの跡などの問題があったので私も正直少し心配していたんですが、今回はかなり改善されたのか私はそういった問題は全くありませんでした！仕上げもすっきりしていますし笑 これから購入される方は心配しなくても大丈夫そうです:)
text.EN:
(mirror's a bit dirty, sorry) This is my one-month Mellow bag review! I bought two bags thinking I could write two reviews and picked out ten photos, but turns out I can only write one review(sob) Sad that each review caps at 5 photos but I'll post what I can (outfit photos go short-long-basic strap from left to right)
1. Design
As you can already tell from the detail page photos, it's obviously so so pretty😍 Every time I take it out people keep asking where it's from, so I've been sharing yyeon's Instagram and promoting it a lot haha My mom said the bag is so pretty the moment she saw it too! I was lucky enough to win a previous event, and the walnut brown color they sent happened to be my mom's favorite color, so I gave her the Mellow bag I won from the event (thanks to yyeon I got to be a good daughter, thank you💗) What surprised me at first was that the bag is smaller than expected? It's a mini size that fits between two palms, adorably cute, but the inner storage was just as roomy as I'd imagined before receiving it, which was really fascinating..! All three colors look great but black especially! It's glossy and the prettiest, photos don't seem to capture it fully. It's my favorite color❤️
+ Oh, I'd really recommend buying the chain strap together with the bag, it's really really really x100000000 pretty and matches the bag so well
2. Styling
On days I need to dress up, the chain strap suited it perfectly, and for casual wear, the basic strap looked great! Like in the photos, even just wearing a plain t-shirt with a denim skirt looks a lot more put-together and luxurious when paired with the chain strap, and for a fully styled outfit, adding both the Mellow bag and chain strap really completes the look. On the flip side, even when dressed casually (more like sloppily...) for a walk, using the basic strap made it easy to carry without feeling burdensome, and since the bag is pretty it kind of offsets my appearance? so I don't look too shabby and can go out looking neat lol Whether dressed up or not, it was great being able to carry it daily, and since I have all three colors I could pick whichever matched my outfit that day, which was the best👍👍 It's so versatile that I've been wearing only the Mellow bag for the past week lol
3. Storage
Actually, having already used both the Henne bag and Blooming bag before receiving this, I already knew the storage would be good, but using it I was surprised it holds even more than expected. The photo I took wasn't even the bag fully packed, there was still a bit of space left, but if you open the snap and expand it, that much fits. Though using the accordion function? makes closing the flap a bit tough. Of course it still closes properly, and note that the zip pocket doesn't fit sanitary pads but fits exactly 2 panty liners! The pouch pocket fits exactly a blush and lip balm, those two items. For phone I use a Flip6, and the Flip fits with plenty of room, and I think bar-type phones would fit fine too unless it's a Galaxy Ultra or iPhone Pro series (though even those might fit?) The card pocket only fits one card but unlike how it looks it's not stiff at all, so taking cards in and out is easy!
4. Other
The previous funding's reviews mentioned issues like peeling gold hardware and glue marks, so I was honestly a little worried too, but it seems they improved things a lot this time since I had zero such issues! The finishing is clean too haha Anyone buying from now on shouldn't need to worry:)

text.KO:
(거울더러움주의) 멜로우백 한 달 사용후기입니다! 가방을 두 개 사서 후기도 하나 더 쓸 수 있는 줄 알고 올릴 사진을 열 장 추려왔는데 후기는 하나밖에 못쓰네요ㅜㅜ 후기 하나당 사진 5개가 최대라 아쉽지만 이거라도 올려봐요 (가방 착샷은 왼쪽부터 순서대로 숏-롱-기본 스트랩 순입니당)

1. 디자인
상세페이지 사진만 봐도 알 수 있듯이 당연히 너무너무 예쁘구요😍 들고나갈때마다 주변에서 어디 가방이냐구 계속 물어봐서 yyeon 인스타 알려주고 열심히 홍보하고 다녔어요ㅎㅎ 엄마도 보자마자 가방 너무 이쁘다구 하시더라구요! 정말 감사하게도 지난 이벤트에 당첨됐었는데 또 마침 보내주신 월넛 브라운 컬러가 저희 엄마 최애 컬러여서 이벤트로 받은 멜로우백은 엄마 드렸어요(yyeon 덕분에 효도했어요 감사해요💗) 처음에 받고 놀랐던건 생각보다 가방이 작다는거? 손바닥 두개로 가려지는 미니사이즈여서 앙증맞고 귀엽고 좋았는데 내부 수납공간은 받기 전에 생각했던 사이즈 그대로 넉넉해서 너무 신기했어요..! 외관은 세 컬러 다 이쁜데 블랙이 특히! 광택이 나서 제일 이뻤고 사진이 실물을 다 못담는거 같아요 제 최애 컬러입니다❤️
+ 아 체인스트랩은 꼭 가방이랑 같이 구매하시는걸 추천드려요 진짜진짜진짜×100000000 이쁘고 가방이랑 잘 어울립니당

2. 코디
차려입고 나가야되는 날에는 체인스트랩, 캐주얼하게 입을때는 기본스트랩이 잘 어울리더라구요! 사진처럼 그냥 평범하게 티에 데님스커트만 입어도 체인스트랩이랑 같이 매치해주면 나름 신경쓴 코디처럼 훨씬 고급스러워지구요, 꾸꾸꾸 코디일때는 더더욱 멜로우백에 체인스트랩까지 걸어주고 나가야 완성이에요. 반대로 캐주얼(이 아니라 후줄근...)하게 입고 산책 나갈때도 기본 스트랩 걸어서 매주면 부담스럽지 않게 맬 수 있으면서도 가방이 이쁘다 보니 제 몰골이 상쇄?되어서 너무 추레하지 않고 깔끔하게 나갈수 있더라구요ㅋㅋ 꾸밀때든 아닐때든 언제든지 데일리로 들고다닐수 있어서 너무 좋았고 더군다나 저는 세컬러나 있어서 그날그날 옷 색깔에 어울리는 컬러로 들고나갈수 있어서 최고였습니다👍👍 범용성이 좋아서 요즘 일주일 내내 멜로우백만 매고 다녀요ㅎㅎ

3. 수납력
사실 받기 전에도 이미 헨느백과 블루밍백을 전부 써본 사람으로서 수납력은 당연히 좋을거라는 걸 알고는 있었지만 실제로 써보니 생각보다도 더 많이 들어가서 놀랐어요. 사진 찍은거는 가방 완전 꽉 채운것도 아니고 공간 조금 남겨놓은 건데도 똑딱이 오픈해서 확장하니까 저만큼이나 들어가더라구요. 다만 아코디언 기능? 쓰면 뚜껑 닫는게 좀 빡세긴 해요 물론 그래도 닫히긴 잘 닫히구요, 지퍼포켓은 생리대는 안들어가고 팬티라이너 딱 두개까지 들어가는거 참고하세요! 파우치포켓에는 블러셔랑 립밤 이렇게 두개정도 딱 들어가요. 폰은 제가 플립6를 쓰는데 플립은 완전 넉넉하게 들어가고 바형 핸드폰도 갤럭시 울트라나 아이폰 프로 시리즈만 아니면 무리없이 들어가지 않을까 싶습니다(울트라나 프로도 들어갈수도?) 카드 포켓에는 딱 카드 하나만 들어가긴 하는데 보기와는 다르게 전혀 뻑뻑하지 않고 카드 넣다뺐다 하기 편했어요!

4. 기타
지난 펀딩때 후기에 금장까짐이나 본드자국 등등 이슈가 있어서 저도 사실 조금은 걱정했는데 이번에는 많이 개선하셨는지 저는 그런 이슈 전혀 없었습니다! 마감도 깔끔하구요ㅎㅎ 앞으로 구매하실분들 걱정 안하셔도 될것 같습니당 :)
text.JA:
（鏡の汚れご注意）メロウバッグ1ヶ月使用後記です！バッグを2個買ったのでレビューをもう一つ書けると思って写真を10枚選んでいたんですが、レビューは1つしか書けないんですね(涙) レビュー1つにつき写真5枚が上限で残念ですが、これだけでもアップしてみます（着用写真は左から順にショート-ロング-基本ストラップの順です）
1. デザイン
詳細ページの写真だけでも分かるように当然すごくすごく綺麗です😍 持って出かけるたびに周りからどこのバッグかとずっと聞かれて、yyeonのインスタを教えてしっかり宣伝してきました笑 母も見た瞬間バッグすごく綺麗だと言ってくれました！本当にありがたいことに以前のイベントに当選したんですが、ちょうど送っていただいたウォルナットブラウンカラーが母の一番好きな色だったので、イベントでもらったメロウバッグは母にあげました（yyeonのおかげで親孝行できました、ありがとうございます💗）最初に受け取って驚いたのは思ったよりバッグが小さいこと？両手のひらで隠れるくらいのミニサイズで可愛らしくて良かったんですが、内部の収納スペースは受け取る前に想像していたサイズそのままに余裕があってすごく不思議でした..! 外観は3色とも綺麗ですが特にブラックが！艶があって一番綺麗で、写真じゃ実物を全部表現しきれない気がします。私の一番好きな色です❤️
+ あ、チェーンストラップは必ずバッグと一緒に購入することをおすすめします、本当に本当に本当に×100000000綺麗でバッグにすごく合います
2. コーディネート
きちんと着飾って出かける日はチェーンストラップ、カジュアルに着る時は基本ストラップがよく似合いました！写真のようにただ普通にTシャツにデニムスカートだけ着てもチェーンストラップと合わせるとそれなりに気を配ったコーデのようにずっと高級感が出ますし、めかしこんだコーデの時はさらにメロウバッグにチェーンストラップまで掛けて出かけてこそ完成です。逆にカジュアル（というより着崩れた感じ...）に着て散歩に出かける時も基本ストラップを掛ければ負担なく持てる上にバッグが綺麗なので私の見た目が相殺？されて、あまりくたびれた感じにならずすっきり出かけられます笑 めかしこんでもそうじゃなくてもいつでもデイリーで持ち歩けてすごく良かったですし、しかも私は3色も持っているのでその日その日の服の色に合う色を選んで持ち歩けて最高でした👍👍 汎用性が良くて最近1週間ずっとメロウバッグばかり掛けています笑
3. 収納力
実は受け取る前からすでにヘンヌバッグとブルーミングバッグを両方使った人間として収納力は当然良いだろうと分かってはいたんですが、実際使ってみたら思ったよりさらにたくさん入って驚きました。写真を撮ったのはバッグを完全にぎっしり詰めたわけでもなくて空間を少し残しておいたものですが、スナップを開けて拡張すればあれだけ入ります。ただアコーディオン機能？を使うと蓋を閉めるのがちょっと大変です。もちろんそれでも閉まりはちゃんと閉まりますし、ジッパーポケットは生理用ナプキンは入らずパンティライナーがちょうど2枚まで入るので参考にしてください！ポーチポケットにはチークとリップバームこの2つがちょうど入ります。携帯は私はFlip6を使っているんですが、Flipは完全に余裕で入りますし、バー型の携帯もGalaxy UltraやiPhone Proシリーズでなければ問題なく入るんじゃないかと思います（UltraやProも入るかも？）カードポケットにはカード1枚だけしか入りませんが見た目と違って全然硬くなくてカードの出し入れが楽でした！
4. その他
前回のファンディングのレビューで金具の剥げやボンドの跡などの問題があったので私も正直少し心配していたんですが、今回はかなり改善されたのか私はそういった問題は全くありませんでした！仕上げもすっきりしていますし笑 これから購入される方は心配しなくても大丈夫そうです:)
text.EN:
(mirror's a bit dirty, sorry) This is my one-month Mellow bag review! I bought two bags thinking I could write two reviews and picked out ten photos, but turns out I can only write one review(sob) Sad that each review caps at 5 photos but I'll post what I can (outfit photos go short-long-basic strap from left to right)
1. Design
As you can already tell from the detail page photos, it's obviously so so pretty😍 Every time I take it out people keep asking where it's from, so I've been sharing yyeon's Instagram and promoting it a lot haha My mom said the bag is so pretty the moment she saw it too! I was lucky enough to win a previous event, and the walnut brown color they sent happened to be my mom's favorite color, so I gave her the Mellow bag I won from the event (thanks to yyeon I got to be a good daughter, thank you💗) What surprised me at first was that the bag is smaller than expected? It's a mini size that fits between two palms, adorably cute, but the inner storage was just as roomy as I'd imagined before receiving it, which was really fascinating..! All three colors look great but black especially! It's glossy and the prettiest, photos don't seem to capture it fully. It's my favorite color❤️
+ Oh, I'd really recommend buying the chain strap together with the bag, it's really really really x100000000 pretty and matches the bag so well
2. Styling
On days I need to dress up, the chain strap suited it perfectly, and for casual wear, the basic strap looked great! Like in the photos, even just wearing a plain t-shirt with a denim skirt looks a lot more put-together and luxurious when paired with the chain strap, and for a fully styled outfit, adding both the Mellow bag and chain strap really completes the look. On the flip side, even when dressed casually (more like sloppily...) for a walk, using the basic strap made it easy to carry without feeling burdensome, and since the bag is pretty it kind of offsets my appearance? so I don't look too shabby and can go out looking neat lol Whether dressed up or not, it was great being able to carry it daily, and since I have all three colors I could pick whichever matched my outfit that day, which was the best👍👍 It's so versatile that I've been wearing only the Mellow bag for the past week lol
3. Storage
Actually, having already used both the Henne bag and Blooming bag before receiving this, I already knew the storage would be good, but using it I was surprised it holds even more than expected. The photo I took wasn't even the bag fully packed, there was still a bit of space left, but if you open the snap and expand it, that much fits. Though using the accordion function? makes closing the flap a bit tough. Of course it still closes properly, and note that the zip pocket doesn't fit sanitary pads but fits exactly 2 panty liners! The pouch pocket fits exactly a blush and lip balm, those two items. For phone I use a Flip6, and the Flip fits with plenty of room, and I think bar-type phones would fit fine too unless it's a Galaxy Ultra or iPhone Pro series (though even those might fit?) The card pocket only fits one card but unlike how it looks it's not stiff at all, so taking cards in and out is easy!
4. Other
The previous funding's reviews mentioned issues like peeling gold hardware and glue marks, so I was honestly a little worried too, but it seems they improved things a lot this time since I had zero such issues! The finishing is clean too haha Anyone buying from now on shouldn't need to worry:)
